All the extras, I pay with the money I make on the market square in Amakna. If I could only find out where he has hidden his fortune, we could finally live decently.

q.6936:
You really want to know? It's very simple: I decided to lock her away because more and more Enutrofs were beginning to worry that she would discover where we were hiding their wealth. You might think it's inhumane, but I can assure you that other people wanted to use more radical methods. You might even say that it was an act of charity on my part. Being imprisoned for ten years is better than being beheaded by several shovels, don't you think?
Now leave me alone, I do not want to dwell on these memories, and you'll get nothing from me anymore. You can always look, but you will not find the tile or its mechanism, hehe.
q.3790: I'll give you a Twiggy Sword for eight wood logs. For four measures of wheat, I'll give you a loaf of hot bread from Amakna. For five flax flowers, how about a potion of mini healings. Have you got a gudgeon? I'll take the guts for my Bow Meow and you can have the rest. I've got a lot of things, stranger. Show me what you got and maybe we can do a deal!
q.6995: I am not an expert in lepidopteran insects that have two pairs of wings covered with scales, which lay eggs that become larvae, which in turn become caterpillars, then form chrysalis to turn into adults, sometimes called imago. I was hunting the souls of creatures to sell to the highest bidder until Otomai offered me a job worthy of my talent. Indeed, he wants to unite the souls of all living creatures, and I was the first to have achieved this goal.

Maskara will be delighted to do so.

q.6946:
I see... a dark crypt, scarlet lips with two long canines protruding from them, demented laughter in the dark.
I feel a muscle tear, excruciating pain.
I see a hammer sinking into darkness and light dissipating. There is a being, or rather an ethereal spirit.
I see a cemetery, then a forest, mountains in the distance, an underground passage, a land of ash and lava.
I see a dark graveyard, spirits in agony, a profound sadness.

q.7032:
You'll need the help of several people. A member of the Order of the Salvatory Spirit who is at least a Follower of Writing, a Xelor that can master the spell 'Clock' and a Sacrier that can master the spell 'Flying Sword'. Various craftsmen should also accompany you, and they must be masters in their art. A Jeweller and a Jewelmagus, a Staff Carver and a Staff Carvemage, a Dagger Smith and a Dagger Smithmagus, and finally an alchemist. No need to bring individual craftsmen along if one person has several of these professions.
Before I forget, do not forget to bring 5 Diamond Stones, 1 Crystal, 1 Mother of Pearl and 1 Tsunami Potion.
I already reserved nine seats with Nikos Monote in Cania Bay, to take you and your companions to the Isle O'Anstitch. If you need more people, you must pay for the extra places yourself.
q.6027: Greetings. How was your trip to Otomai Island? Have you any news about the Dofus?
q.6906:
Really? I suppose that the thief is the person who came to see me, which would mean that I'm partly at fault for the theft as it was me that told the thief.
I know the location of another of these hammers, but I must warn you: it was used to seal the crypt of a powerful vampire. Therefore, if you take the hammer, the vampire will be free to go out and haunt Amakna at will. As you belong to the militia of the City of Light, I suppose you are able to gather enough forces to destroy this monster, which is why I'll help you find it.
The underground crypt is accessible through another crypt in the Amakna Cemetery, but I do not know which one. However, I think that a book in Library of Brakmar, recounts the history of the hammer and how it was hidden in the crypt. It certainly shows how to open the underground passage. Bring it to me and we'll have a look at it together.

q.7011:
Flutterthoughts? Few people are aware of their existence, and fewer still are those that can hunt them. Let me explain how they work.
In the Dragoturkey Territory, near Agony V'Helley, there is a dark tower. It is at the foot of the tower that the flutterthoughts live, and nowhere else.
Some very particular, tiny caterpillars are born in the flower fields around the tower. Once they have captured a lost thought, they form a cocoon, commonly called a chrysalis, to become flutterthoughts a few weeks later. If the pupa is destroyed before maturity, the thought is lost forever.

q.7012:
It is not really possible to identify a lost thought, although Greu Nouille and I have already identified certain categories. For example, flutterthoughts related to the lost thoughts of exceptional beings are easily identifiable by their unique features. The more the thought is lost, the more impressive the flutterthought is, and that's without mentioning the colours of its wings.
We also found that each disciple of the gods has its own form of flutterthought. Iops, for example, often lose the thread of their thoughts. For this reason their flutterthoughts are numerous, but small.
If you intend to capture a flutterthought, heed this warning: whoever touches a flutterthought becomes amnesiac, that's what happened to me recently.

q.6369:
Shush!
The horn we are talking about was part of a creature named Thelama who terrorised the distant province of Pandala.
During an evening spent asking for the goddess' help - some texts present this evening as a simple drinking session - the young Pandawushu disciple Fogornleg swore to his Master that he would defeat Thelama. Three months later, after Thelama had not been seen for five moons, Fogornleg's body was found, a bloody horn in his hand. Of Thelama there was no trace except the horn and so Fogornleg's Master gave it the name of his deceased disciple who had the courage to keep his promise at the cost of his life.
Thereafter, it became clear that the horn was vested with powerful magic which the Master Pandawa often use when they paid homage to the goddess. But what shouldn't have come to pass came to pass, and while recovering from an entire night spent praying to the goddess, the Horn was stolen.

But maybe you have a key?

Did Elviana send you? I'd like to go with you but I've to find my two brothers, Aigurraf and Tabach. They're likely to do all sorts of crazy stuff considering their distressed state.

q.6379:
Herr Palp Itane was a Wabbit who once challenged Elturt during the Cania marathon. Unfortunately, his pretentiousness and his arrogance led him straight to defeat. He never got over the humiliation inflicted by Elturt and so followed the migration of his kind to the Lenald Island where he had some semblance of revenge when he was again confronted with Elturt. Although very old now, there remains great power within him which, according to some rumours, is the result of a pact with darkness. For my part, I can't see Rushu or one of his henchmen having a pact with a Wabbit, no matter how powerful it is.
However, after a failed coup d'etat he took refuge on Skeleton Wabbit Island to avoid the wrath of the Wa Wabbit, which proves that he's not so powerful after all.
q.3140:
Did Rosal feed you some hallucinogenic flowers or what? 
To be honest, I don't know how you can get permission since every time a crank like you asks me this question, I send them to the four sisters... and none have ever come back. All cowards.
q.4421: A battle is taking place in the plains on the road between Bonta and Brakmar. I want you to join in and help steer our warriors to victory!
q.1635:
Very well, altruism is a rare virtue in our time. Plus, it's always good for the protection of the country to have new warriors fighting for our cities.

q.1231: I wasn't working last night. The only one here was that drunkard over there...
q.1198:
Very good, you have yet remembered my first lesson: give the different choices a lot of thought before making your final decision.
Come back when you're absolutely sure.

q.336:
Sorry, I can't teach you this profession, you don't have enough practice in the other one. 
You can't learn a new profession until you've mastered your current one. Come back again when you've improved...
q.596: Hard hats are not compulsory in the mines but it's strongly recommended. I've just invented a stronger type of hard hat. All you have to do is to collect 10 Black Gobball leathers, 10 linen Strings, 5 units of Gobball wool and, of course, the help of a good tailor.
q.6099: Greetings, I see that you have grown in strength since I last saw you. Have you pitilessly massacred many Bontarians lately?
q.1815:

q.3532: A goblin disciple? Why not! I'll train him very quickly. His brain won't accept many spells in any case.

Since you're here, you'll be on fatigue duty. First of all, go have a look at the sewers and while you're at it kill a few rats to clear off the entry... Bring their carcasses back, we'll use the meat for dinner. We'll be 10 this evening so bring 10 carcasses at least!
q.2508: Just repeat to yourself 5 times, Trouble, trouble, soil and bubble, Mire turn to solid rubble! and you'll be cured. But I must warn you that our island can be very dangerous when it comes to happy-go-lucky adventurers!
q.131: Beer is made by the brewers of Amakna. There are several different kinds, depending on what cereal is used, Malt, Hops or Barley, for example. The most powerful beers can have spectacular, unexpected effects.
q.3015: The only thing I know about it's that they sell well... (suddenly giving you a suspicious look).
q.1176:
A hellhound here, within the White City?
Out of my sight!
q.2185: A healing stone? You took too much time to bring it to me... its power returned to nature. You have to bring it to me in less than 20 minutes. Do this for me and I'll set it in confinement metal.
q.954: The fort is located in the centre of the city. It's both the training centre and the headquarters of the militia. You'll have to speak to Master Amayiro if you want to join our ranks.
q.4607: Hello, I'm pleased you were able to find out more about Elturt. It looks as though we don't have much choice but to go to the Wa Castle and find the bandana. Take these 1,000 Kamas for the journey, and take a few good friends with you. The Wa Wabbit's well known for his love of a good fight and I don't think his Wobots will give up the bandana very easily.
q.961: The main aim of the militia is to protect the inhabitants of Bonta against Brakmarian attacks. We're also here to help you and to give information on the city. Don't hesitate to go visit Master Amayiro if you wish to join us. I've heard he's looking for new spies. You'll find him in the fort, in the centre of the city.

q.2763:
A long time ago, Pandawas often made generous libations to their goddess Pandawa.
At the end of the ceremonies, some Pandawas would go into a trance due to the fermented bamboo vapours... before collapsing. In a spirit of brotherhood, some followers did not hesitate to carry some of them home. That's the point where the history joins the legend: we don't really know if it was plain drunken hallucination or real evil but the intoxicated Pandawas would always fight their companions as they were being carried back home! These gesticulations and blind clouts are the origin of the Pandawa art of self-defence.
q.4259: With this staff, I'll be able to carve you a particularly efficient scythe shaft. The only thing left to do is to take apart the blade of your sword.
q.6819: I've not eaten anything yet today so I'm just preparing some slices of Farle's Pig before my next game of cards with Ares Truer.

A low-ranking Bontarian militiaman carrying special equipment?
Hmm, that's very worrying. Could the Bontarians have found a better way to equip their soldiers?
I see you've beaten him. Excellent, that means one less to fight and it'll knock their confidence. You've shown me that no one has the right to treat us like puppets. I'm starting to like you.

You just have to learn to live with the weather and to flout the agricultural regulations - they want us to leave our fields fallow every second year! Imagine that. Ha!

q.1581:
It's not for me, I've met a Grace Malcean a little further down south and she has problems with her Tabi.
She's a member of the Bontarian Parliament and it would be harmful for my electorate if she suffered from a nervous breakdown at the moment.
q.4437:
A stupid old Sadida is hanging around Brakmar telling everyone we should stop praising Djaul and follow the way of our ancestors.
I want you to eliminate him before our citizens hear his mad raving.
q.4524:

First, we need to open this door, thanks to the slabs and to the four rooms...

Those who succeed in opening the door, are worthy of meeting the beast.
q.404:
The profession of Miner is a difficult one. You must like darkness and mustn't be afraid of taking on Cracklers armed only with a pick.
This profession is nevertheless rewarding, you can become rich without too much trouble, as long as you work in the good mines.
The essential equipment to the miner is the pick. Take good care of it and don't let it get rusty.
q.1018:
It looks like you've forgotten the beer, silly blighter. 
Start again and hurry up this time!
You really have to spoon-feed these awkward lumps...
q.1406: AHHH YES... I LOVE THE SKY-BLUE SKY! SO WHAT?! I'm A BRAKMARIAN AFTER ALL!
q.1516: The problem, impatient youth, has its roots in the emergence of Djaul's worshippers. More and more Brakmarians worship this demon without honour. People no longer believe in a blow for blow. They want everything to perish, not only Bonta. The dark balance is in danger. Djaul's worship threatens the general peace. All Brakmarians have a passion for darkness but now, they're divided by the way they venerate it.

q.2423: The fisherman's trade requires more patience than any other work. A fisherman basically catches fish that he cleans before selling it to fishmongers. q.1021:
Hem, in the end I'm too swamped with work to take care of my sabre myself.
Go to the Blacksmiths district and ask Kosuke to repair my blade.
q.4164:
We were supposed to find a new world, live a new life and fall in love all over again. 
Our euphoria was as intense as it was brief. Look at me now... I had to run away to make my husband react... even if I know that I'm going to hurt him by behaving like this. Please explain this to him. He can be as innocent as a Kaniger and as stubborn as a Pikoko sometimes. But his defects are also part of him and I love him just as he's. Please, talk to him, and with a bit of luck he'll understand and we'll be able to start all over again.
q.3362: Modifications brought by the update are listed on the official forums, in the Logbook section.
q.366:
Ah, I like your style! If you win, you'll get the whole pot!
Otherwise, half of this amount will go towards the jackpot...
q.4525: Ah, you're back. Danathor wanted to see you again. You're starting to make a name for yourself round these parts... everyone wants to hire you!

Stop.

Good luck!

q.1440:
Hemm! Amayiro wants more evidences...take this confession, it will be more convincing...
Otherwise I don't know... you can ask Ture Inge how to lead an investigation, he may have some suggestions...
q.7569: Ah, I see you don't mess about! You're ready to explore the vast continent of Amakna, and then some.
q.4838: Ah, you're back. Did everything go as planned?
q.1062: Ah, it's for the training? Well, take this and hurry!

q.4925:
The forging of the Dawn Shard, the weapon used by the Wise Jiva, requires exotic materials.
As you probably know, Jiva is the symbol of loyalty to the gods, particularly towards Xelor, and so it is logical that the Dawn Shard's powers reflect the mastery of time. This is why we must steal a fragment of time.
The problem is, to steal time, one must have access to Xelor's Clock. But no one has access except the Demons of the Hours, who to my knowledge are best placed to do this mischief. Once again, it will be necessary to contact one of them.
According to some of my contacts, recent rumours say that the Rogues are dealing with the Demons of the Hours. Although they are merely rumours, it's the only lead available to us. You must make your way to their hideout and haggle with them until you get a stolen Fragment of Time.
q.3879: Ah, very good! You found a way to return! Congratulations! Okay, now, go and find Vil. Whatever you do, please don't start a fight with him! I only want to talk!

Hey, I need something to ease this pain, a Boowolf yanked out my moustache in a fight and it's killing me, so if you have any bread to spare, I'll take it off your hands. 
I bet you've never met Wiss Catz, have you?
q.3030: Hola amigo! Life is only worth living when you're on a battlefield, isn't it true? Virile trainings and moonlight patrols, are what you really want to do? And I haven't mentioned the loyal friendship between the militia of Bonta yet! So are you in?
q.4945: Ah, you're back. I just received a troubling report. Troops from Brakmar led be Oto Mustam himself were seen coming from Amakna. I sent a group of elite troops there and I want you to join them under the command of officer Imagiro. The soldiers have set up camp near the Iop temple. I've marked it out on your map for you.
q.5050: Ah, you're back. I found out what was happening in Amakna and I think Danathor is going too far. It's not wise to carry on business with Amakna that damages relations between the towns, especially considering all the trouble that's been going on. When you go back to Amakna, try to calm things down with Sergeant Graccia
q.6096: Ah, you're back. I presume that your presence means the Assembly is over?
q.5853: Ah, you're back. I was wondering what happened. Did anything strange happen in Amakna while you were there?
q.315:
Stop laughing and go find me 10 Moskito Wings. I must come up with a brilliant idea and I'm short of Moskito Wings, they help me think. 
You obviously don't deserve it but I'll find a way to reward you.
q.4283: It's you! You'll never guess what happened to me.
q.3363:
Huh? You made it? You really made it?
Err... So... I didn't think you have them... blablablabla.... Twelve billion used Bwork protections... that's not it... Ah! Here... Bring the six Dofus. So... I must give you...
...

Hummm. Are you ready for your reward?
q.6491:
Huhuhuheeheehee HIARHIARHIARHAHAHA!
I changed my mind and I wanted to give you the information for free, but since you insist... I'll take the sapphire.
Huhuhuheeheehee HIARHIARHIARHAHAHA!
You don't have access to the poison reserves, they're next to the Carvers' Marketplace. Only people who have a natural talent for spying can get in there by taking out the hidden mechanisms that block the way in. On top of that, there are traps all over the place, and you'll need to have at least one person with you to open the grilles. Since you don't have any friends, I guess that means you're in trouble.
Huhuhuheeheehee HIARHIARHIARHAHAHA!
q.1330: HYYAAAAH, By Jiva, the poor Wabbits! YOU'RE A BRUTE, GET OUT!
q.2841:
Someone from the Order of the Sharp Eye has brought us the hides of three Bontarian renegades. We need to study them, but the usual methods of resurrection don't seem to work. 
Bring me a work entitled 'Erzal's Blessing' from the library.
q.6475:
I understand, you must feel terrible. No more beautiful evenings under the stars on the Cania Plains. No one to keep you company through the long nights. No one to lick your face in the morning.
The loss of a pet is always hard to take but I've heard that there's a way to bring a ghost pet to life. You should find a Cemetery in the swamp and overcome all the challenges you encounter there.
q.3917: Ahem, I dunno know what my uncle's up to this time. My nurse came to the castle and took my measurements for a dress. How Weird is that! I've been wearing the same stupid thing for ages and now everyone wants to make me a new dress!
q.4086: Ahem, according to your constitution, I can tell that I'll need a Great Coralator relic, a Gourlo the Terrible relic and a Greater Bherb relic to prepare your potion. Once ground to powder, I'll be able to withdraw all the magic power I need from them.
q.4210: Ahem, according to your constitution, I can tell that I'll need a Great Coralator relic and a Gourlo the Terrible relic to prepare your potion. Once ground to powder, I'll be able to withdraw all the magic power I need from them.
q.4178:
I'm Crocodyl Dandy. I sew naughty underwear from Crocodyl scales, hypnotise plain boars with my fingers, and have a burning desire to turn this island into a Theme Park!
I'm sure that adventurers who crave new experiences will enjoy this island, though it's filled with all these dangerous creatures. Modern adventurers like to be thrilled but not to take risks. Unfortunately, since the creatures escaped from their cages and now evolve freely in the wild, I had to give up my theme park idea. Now, I must come up with something new.
q.1206: Leave me alone with my grief... He left, you understand? Left!
q.7537: Which Doploons do you want to exchange?
q.2690: I'm the best Pandawaiian Shield Maker in the world! And I invite any of my apprentices to try to outdo me. This is the best and fastest way to progress for them as well as for me... Remember that.
q.4209: Ahem, according to your constitution, I can tell that I'll need a Great Coralator relic to prepare your potion. Once ground to powder, I'll be able to withdraw all the magic power I need from it.
q.7878:
Good luck to you, then! Or as a colleague of mine once put it,  
 
"A world of dreams and adventures awaits!" 
... or something like that. He can be a bit daft at times.
q.6822: I have other fish to fry. Why don't you look for someone else to bother with your questions?
q.2642: I'm the most popular person on this island, and the most beautiful, and the strongest and I'm not scared of anything or anybody! Mouahahaha! Hum, excuse me, do you need something?
q.4827: I was appointed clerk because my Order is neutral in this conflict. Talk about luck...*Yawns*
q.9641: *You draw the "Cania Calling" card. What do you decide to do?*
q.4212: Ahem, according to your constitution, I can tell that I'll need a Great Coralator relic, a Gourlo the Terrible relic, a Greater Bherb relic and a Tynril relic to prepare your potion. Once ground to powder, I'll be able to withdraw all the magic power I need from them.
q.5564: I've just got here. I haven't cast the spell yet. If the potion is contaminated, I'd rather you have it. Take it.
q.4087: Ahem, according to your constitution, I can tell that I'll need a Great Coralator relic, a Gourlo the Terrible relic, a Greater Bherb relic and a Tynril relic to prepare your potion. Once ground to powder, I'll be able to withdraw all the magic power I need from them.
q.2231: Ahhh, my cake! Nothing's better than a sugary treat when I'm forging swords. I'm telling you, you have good timing!
q.4088: Ahem, according to your constitution, I can tell that I'll need a Great Coralator relic, a Gourlo the Terrible relic, a Greater Bherb relic, a Tynril relic and a Kimbo relic to prepare your potion. Once ground to powder, I'll be able to withdraw all the magic power I need from them.
q.38: I'm Graham Finame. Everybody around here knows me, and any monster that chanced upon my sharpened blade is now a dead monster. If you're interested, I'm selling everything you need to become a blacksmith.
q.665: I'm Hel Munster. Many people associate my name with the best wizardry in Amakna. But I'm just a humble searcher through the annals of magic and anything connected to it. As for research, I've never been that busy...
q.1286:
I'm Captain Essacarf, the warder here in the militia prison.
No matter how close I watch them, Brakmarians never fail to escape at the first opportunity...
q.6982: Hmmmm. Wyrmwell. That rings a bell. Oh, yes, I remember! Farmhand Ruprecht, an expert in dragon lore, told me about it during an orgy. It's him you need to ask, he settled in the breeder village, among the Koalaks. That reminds me, he still owes me ten lashes.
q.4226: I'm Kroula, prophet of a fearsome monster... What is hiding behind this door scuppered any hopes of your returning home. Mayhem as he wakens at dawn, the terrible sound of the King of the island, the King of the World!
q.4951: Ahh, little cockroach. I have some big plans I need your help with. I can't move like I could before with these cursed shackles on my feet. I need you to cooperate with me and to work efficiency on any tasks I give you.
q.4001: I'm way too strong for you but if you beat my best disciple, I'll serve your prince.
q.6987: Dardondakal the Wise was one of the three white dragons. Due to his nature, he was fairly close to the city of Bonta. The black dragons were suspected of having murdered him in the year 128, and it was for this reason that the white dragon Croulaklakoss flew to Bonta's rescue when the city was besieged by hordes of crocodyls led by Crocoburio. Indeed, the black dragon Grougalorasalar, Crocoburio's father, often trailed in the wake of his son, and Croulaklakoss jumped at the chance to avenge the death of his brother. The fight was rough but ended with the death of Grougalorasalar, which also put an end to the massacres perpetrated by Crocoburio, who was killed by the Bontarians.
q.925: Hello sweetheart! Welcome to Bagrutte's Inn!
q.6836: Really? We don't have a moment to lose. Ask Ture Inge how far he's got with Gnirreh and ask him if he needs your help. I'll do my best to delay the trial. I've just got a new recruit who is doing cleaning chores, they will be delighted to learn that they have more time to clean the court.
q.7891:
*sneers mockingly* 
 
The old man's had one over on you, mate. I've got the last card right here. A monster so rare, even the greatest researchers have never heard of it. 
 
Want to see it? Better yet, hand me your binder for a second, and I'll put it right in where it goes...
q.2783: I think I'm gonna stay here for a while. Just enough time for all my friends to recover. Plus, I've come across a nice shop assistant whose hair is as soft as my beard! Her eyes are like two Rubies and... she drinks more than I do! I'm not leavin' without tryin' to put my pickaxe into her li'l heart! That's for sure! I could even take my bag of jewels out, and that's something! I feel young again!
q.6993: Merlin is correct, I'm a specialist in astral projection and the separation of body and mind. That said, I do not know how to find and capture a lost thought, because my powers are limited to the present, not the past. However, I remember having heard about flutterthoughts in the breeder village, during a trip to the Koalak Mountains. You should go there and talk to its inhabitants, with a little luck you'll find someone who could tell you more about them.
q.4291: I think you can guess what your next job will be. Go to the Drunken Pandawa Inn between 4 pm and midnight, meet Xephires and speak to him about our proposition. A big sac of Kamas is waiting for him if he plays along.
q.544: I'm thinking of exploring the island, there's bound to be treasure buried somewhere. While I'm on this expedition, I'm going to gather loads of different things to make a raft and get out of here.
q.4361: Ahh, yes, I think I remember. Lodax.
q.460: Ahoy matey! Fancy a little trip? While I was sailing round the world in 80 days, I discovered, a really pleasant island, inhabited by strange creatures. We put some of them on a spit, and I can tell you their meat is absolutely delicious. If you're interested in a little gastronomic voyage, I can give you a return ticket for 500 Kamas.
q.6262: Aie! It's Oto Mustam! He ordered the delay of the transfer just in case Bonta tried something stupid. He wasn't wrong.
q.2917:
I hope you're bringing me good news, young spy #1!
What can I do for you?
q.4371: Aie. You didn't manage to protect the convoy, that bothers me a lot. The bandits will now feel untouchable and their attacks will become more daring. All the same, we're not giving up hope just yet.
q.6427:
Ecaflips? Hah, didn't see no Ecaflips.
What is an Ecaflip anyway?
q.666:
I'll only teach you the basics of how to make magic equipment under the following conditions:
- First, you must master the making of standard equipment.
- Then, you must prove to me that you deserve my teaching.
q.5632: I believe that Xelor gives too many powers to his disciples and that Fecas are just useless, even though no one in Amakna dares to tell them so.
q.4373: I had a meeting with some of my superiors and although we didn't all agree from the outset, we finally decided to set a trap for the bandits. A priceless jewel will be transported to Astrub, but I'll make sure a few elite militiamen will be expecting the robbers.
q.4066:
I discovered this island several years ago - I've to admit that luck played a part. I was looking for a kind of new Eden, an island untouched by all the perversions that plague the continent...
I arrived by chance - I was shipwrecked here while searching for another island. In fact, luck couldn't have been kinder to me, this island is just perfect.
q.4768: All your nightmares have come true little one. Oto will be pleased with the power of this blade.
q.5529: All the best for your new life in Amakna.
q.1772: I've trained some Dopples to fight like Ecaflips. They make good training adversaries no matter what your level is.
q.4484: I've another mission for you. I recently received a letter from Xephires. We did well to get him on our side... there's a Bontarian ship called The Panta Maria that's going to be filled to bursting with all sorts of magical objects. They're on their way to the Port of Madstredam for unloading and you're the one who's going to relieve them of their precious cargo before any more ships come to escort them. First of all you should question Lily their captain to see if the ship has already arrived. And I don't need to tell you that if you fail, you'll be tortured the Tofoone way.
q.2697: Hum, well a fake Dofus... but it's been sculpted into precious ore by a handy little Enutrofette... Trust me!
q.737: I put in a word for you with Danathor, the steward of Bonta, some time ago and he'd like to meet you. Why? I don't know, he may ask you a favour or offer you a present...
q.753:
I've an investigation for you: try to find information on AncestralZ. He's a masked pseudo-dispenser of justice who pretends to lay down the law, but I'm the law!
Talk to every inhabitants of Bonta and find the rotter.

(One of them is lying and the others protect him, your goal is to find the good one.)
q.2542: I said, 'first bring a Pandapiler to the master of Akwadala!'
q.2154: Oh, a visitow in my fowest, you awe vewy bwave to ventuwe hewe.
q.4620: Back already? Did Magus Ax give you any information about the horn?
q.4464:
I've received a troubling report. Some of our warriors were defeated and left for dead on the way to Astrub. Whoever did it's still hanging around there as we speak.
I want you to go investigate... and find the culprit!
q.2676: Don't come back if you don't have what I asked you - a Pandapils!
q.169: I need Ash Wood to keep the tavern's fire lit but I don't have time to go get any myself. If you bring me one unit, I'll give you some water in return.
q.1619: I'm afraid of heights, though it might seem strange for a citizen of this village. I've been suffering from vertigo since my childhood. To calm me down, my mother used to give me jelly sweets... ohh that calmed me down alright.
q.6612: That's the little Bontarian girl we gave a good spanking, isn't it?
q.5646: I've followed your journey, Knife Fighter. You're evolving, but you're not evolving quickly enough. If you wish to rise through the ranks of our Order, you'll have to buy some socks and pull them up.
q.2805: You're in the Village of Terrdala. But only those who have recently proven their strength can enter.
q.6011: Crocodyl Dandy? Yeah, that's me. Did you come to try on my Mopy King fabric g-string?
q.4310: I haven't seen you in a long while. I thought the Giant Kralove had swallowed you whole. Don't forget to go have a drink with the other militiamen from time to time. I hate nothing more than a fool who thinks about work all the time.
q.2861: I've nothing to teach you at the moment. Come back later.
q.7894:
No need to explain; I saw it all. To be honest, I knew he was watching you, but I didn't want to say anything. I wouldn't have thought for a second that you'd be taken in that easily. 
 
Aaargh! How could my brilliant mind have overlooked this possibility?!
q.4208:
I lost my bet. I bet that you'd lose this fight after a few minutes. Defeating the Kimbo on his own slaying ground is a great achievement, worthy of a hero. With a bit of luck, you could take on a Gigantic Kralove or even a dragon. Otomai was right, creatures like us all have a weak point and end up being replaced. It's natural... irreversible evolution.
Even you, one day you'll end up in the stomach of a creature who proved stronger than you. It will probably choke on your swollen head though, so you might have the last laugh after all! Take this reward. Otomai once told me that it's very valuable.
q.1309: Ha-ha-ha, what a bunch of idiots! Well, you're very efficient, I must say!
q.493: I have no letter to send him right now.
q.4547: The militia is ready to defend our city, but I'd love to know how the Brakmarians are planning to attack. The sooner we find out how they're planning to attack the better we can organise our defence and minimise losses.
q.1375: I haven't got all the samples I need for my research so I can't write a thorough report.
q.6154: So what about those souls I asked you for?
q.715:
I've another mission for you, more interesting than the last one.
My friend Ned is a dental fanatic and for his latest dentures, he just needs some replacement teeth to make a full set.
I think you can easily deal with that matter, can't you?
q.6742: I haven't seen anything out of the ordinary for the moment, but I'll keep my eye open.
q.5919: An evil little crow? Isn't that original. I don't know which to pick out of all these. Come and see me when you know which one you want to get rid of.
q.5918: An evil little crow? That's the taste of a Brakmarian alright. I suppose the black feathers go nicely with Morgan Faym'n's jet black hair. Go to the Astrub Tavern and find a Bontarian spy by the name of Yve Konpetmin - he's suceeded in infiltrating the enemy... Now run along and do what you have to do, and let me get on with my business. And don't breathe a word about our little arrangement to anyone, ok.
q.5021: An order slip for a A 638 Dwarf Bus! Thank Danathor for me.
q.687:
And here is the second question,
How can you measure the attention
Within a couple of lovers.
In terms of quantity, it will be better.
q.5717:
I spoke about you to various Order masters and they're prepared to accept you into their ranks. You'll have to go to the Bontarian Tower of Orders where they'll help you choose a path.
There's no rush, you've all the time in the world to choose an Order, and you won't be roped into anything.
q.494:
I have to send him messages on a regular basis. If you deliver him this letter, I'll give you 1,000 Kamas and your reputation in our clan will grow..
You'll find him to the south of the dark forest of Amakna.
q.2450: This is where we lock up Amakna's worst criminals. If you ever capture one, bring them to me.
q.648:
I've had the Forgetfulness recipe for a while now, engraved upon a bow in order to remember it. Well here you're then :
Forgetfulness of Magic arrow : 4 Flexible Woods, 5 Rings of Mental State, 10 Bows of Pure Crystal, 1 Water.
I hope this helps.
q.6322: I just got some bad news and I'm really not in the mood to hear any more. If you have some encouraging information, speak up, otherwise, get out of here before I tear you limb from limb.
q.2921: I've some bad news. Some Bontarians have joined the ranks of Brakmar. There aren't any Renegade Hunters around right now, but if you bring me the hides of the Bontarian deserters, you can become a hunter yourself. I don't know where they are exactly, but a spy named Bishom Pot may be able to give you more information.
q.6342: And who else exactly do you want me to work for? Aren't we in Bonta after all? You should think twice before asking such idiotic questions.
q.2528: Are you here for a libation to the goddess?
q.6166: I've many precious gifts to offer the brave adventurers who help me find what I'm looking for. Even I can't truly explain how I found these Dofus. Some say it was blind luck, other are convinced it was my destiny. But I like to think that my own hard work and research lead me to the most beautiful and dangerous prizes that exist in the World of Twelve.
q.4929:
I will not fail to mention your more-than-effective participation to Amayiro and the other Order Masters.
f you have nothing else to do, go back to Amayiro. He's not short of missions and he always needs help from someone.
q.488:
I've sent one of my disciples, Yrun Teullair, to steal the manual of the Tailor of Amakna. Unfortunately, he didn't come back. I'm afraid he might have decided to keep it for himself. 
If you bring the intact manual back to me, you'll be fairly rewarded.
q.4639: So, you Trool Dung Beetle turd, are you happy with your new mission?
q.6456:
I had some problems with an Ecaflip who matched your description. He had really bad manners and spent the whole night on my case. The innkeeper had to call the militia to get the guy out of there.
You want to know which militiaman? Wow, I really couldn't say. I don't know them all, but they were definitely accompanied by Captain Alrok. I remember because he came to ask if I was okay afterwards. If you want to find him, he'll be posted at the Bonta Zaap.
q.2484: Are you looking for some Amber around here? I think you should go south of Amakna to find some, close to the forest.
q.6818: An owl spelling 'Scram'? What in the name of the great Enutrof are you talking about? Stop talking nonsense and go bet on the outcome of the next fight.
q.2607:
Are you saying this underpass leads to the lair of some awful creature?
Humm, now I understand the meaning of this huge skull on my manuscript. Hmm, let's see... so... the next one is to the north of the village. Just head for the Treechnid Forest, and you can't miss it... I'm sure you're dying to have another go...
q.2405: Are you sure you really want to become a Shoemaker?
q.3147: I hope you're proud of yourself! You stepped on my boomerang and now it doesn't work properly. It doesn't fly into my hands anymore, it shoots straight for my opponents! It's unbearable! You're nothing but a dirty Piwi killer, an Arachnee-batterer, a Dragoturkey beheader!
q.831:
I heard this morning that it's possible to communicate with the dead when you're a spirit.
I want you to kill yourself, find my father's body in the Brakmar cemetery, and ask him where he hid his will. I've been looking for it for years!
His grave is in the centre of the cemetery. There should still be a big bunch of flowers on it...
q.1858: I wouldn't mind a little help actually. We need a lot more Gobbly wool for our stock. If by any chance you could go shear some beasts...
q.2378: Are you sure you want to start a new career as a Staff Sculptor?
q.2379: Are you sure you want to start a new career as a Wand Sculptor?
q.4513: I can't work here, I just can't bear hearing those cries of agony every time the Moowolf sits down to eat. I need a quieter place, where less people pass by. every time I hear footsteps I'm afraid someone has come to get me. Who would want to hurt me? Well... lots of people. Smiths who are jealous of my skill, or thieves, or even the ghosts of monsters out for revenge...
q.6409:
Now that is a tasty salad. Lots of meat, not much veg. It would be even better if you swapped the vegetables for more pieces of meat.
You want to know how to prepare it? I don't have a clue, I'm afraid. Only certain adventurers who have mastered both butchery and hunting know the recipe. I remember a Cania hunter that used to eat it all the time, what was his name? Sam the Sif, Sim the Sweet...Sim the Soft! He often trains to the south of the Blop Dungeon, I'll mark the dungeon's location on your map for you. A little bit of meat for the road?
q.6699: What a sordid place, I hope not to languish here too long.
q.3157:
And do you know why I'm the best? Obviously you don't. You're way too stupid #1, you don't know a thing, so let me explain it to you.
I'm the best because I built the best ship on the continent. It's more beautiful that all the flower fields of Rosal, it can resist Rushu's flames, and it's faster than a featherless Tofu falling out of a tree. I discovered the Minotoror Island with this ship a long time ago.
q.1107: Raaaah! My horn! Where is my hooooorn!
q.7071: At the very end of this cave, my father and his followers do live. What I'd really like is if you could get all the way to him. If he's had an accident, I'll take his place. I never told you that, of course!
q.2996: Are you trying to fool me? I wrote that one. You probably found it in a library! Go back there and take a copy of the Dragon Era!
q.7904:
Greetings, warrior, and welcome to the Gladiatrool!  
If you're looking for epic battles that you won't find anywhere else, you've come to the right place. Together or with an ally, try to complete all 10 of my challenges. I'll even provide the weapons and the tonics! 
 
Unfortunately, I don't think you've got quite enough experience yet to face off against my creatures. Come back once you've earned your stripes!
q.4073:
I can see you're starting to regret all this... It's about time!
However, I won't forgive you that easily. You'll have to be useful at least once in your life.
q.6172:
Excellent, you've made the right decision!
Go quickly to Oto Mustam in the Brakmarian Militia and tell him I sent you. There's a shortcut to get to the dark city, I've drawn it on your map for you. 
Actually, don't tell anyone else about this little favour as Astrubian militiamen aren't allowed to recruit on behalf of the big cities. It's our little secret, OK?
q.4131:
I know this island. It's full of pirates and Kokokos. I'm not afraid of Kokokos. I've been brought up among a primitive Kokoko tribe when I was young and believe me, these creatures are stupider than Iops! However, beware of pirates. They're evil, vile, sly, pervert, dirty and their breath is worse than that of a stuffed Bherb. Well, we must hurry and repair my ship.
I'll need wood... now, manage to find some on this island. You must also find Flib's Cursed Chest. It's a living chest that I abandoned on this island. It contains the necessary tools to fix the ship's sail.
q.6242: I've known Xephires for a few years and I can tell you that I probably wouldn't be as famous as I've been since I won the Amakna's Got Talent contest. All the same, he doesn't seem to like you, which is why I'm going to have to ask you to stop bothering us.
q.6171:
You're not as stupid as you look, are you. Would you be interested in joining the ranks of the defenders of Bonta? If so, I can offer you a purse full of Kamas and teach you a few veteran tricks that'll be of great use in a fight. 
So, what do you say?
q.6579: I came with thirty years of tough practice behind me, I found some travelling companions who wanted to steal Chafer bones. Everything was going fine until the Eniripsa and the Feca abandoned us, saying that their mother wanted them back home. Seriously though... can you believe it? Leaving us there in a dungeon to fend for ourselves? My other companions tried to get out, but they were slain and chopped up into little square pieces. As for me, I dug a hole with my spade and make a ladder with the leftovers of my travelling companions. I'm lucky that none of the monsters from above have ventured down here yet. So how about we get out of here together?
q.6415: By the Twelve, how is that possible? You...you're poor! With your odd, country bumpkin appearance I had a few doubts, I've to admit. Reassure me, it's not contagious, is it? Here, take this recipe and go away, I don't want to catch it.
q.4672: At the moment, I've something else I'd like you to do. A Sram owes me some money, and it's already been two months since I asked her to pay me back. She must be skint, so find her, and eliminate her. Don't let her hoodwink you, she's a real smooth talker - if you listen to a word she says, you'll end up skint yourself. Believe me, I know what I'm talking about. I know exactly what you're thinking, and you'd be wrong. She didn't hoodwink me, oh no. She owes me money for something else. I'm too clever for her, do you hear? She loves to gamble, you'll find her if you ferret around in the illegal gaming rooms.
q.4204: I only let the most courageous adventurers venture in this old lab. Prove your worth and go help my friend, Captain Futchure defeat his sworn enemy, Gourlo the Terrible. I lost a whole supply of Greedo Rum over him and I'll never forgive that. Most importantly, bring me the Bherb Gully Key if you wish to gain entry.
q.3283:
I'm not joking! You should have seen it with your very eyes to realize how impressive it was! 
I took advantage of this situation and used my boat as a bridge and I made tourists pay to go to Moon Island without having to use this stupid cannon!
I became so rich after that that I put up the money for the construction of the bridge to Pandala and the reconstruction of Bonta's great wall, just for fun!
Later, my boat disappeared, sucked up at the bottom of the Asse Sea, by the Giant Kralove from Moon Island.
q.2815: As you may know, if you've read the book of Myamowa Musashwan, Pandawas are equally comfortable with all the elements. It's up to you to find your own way amongst the four!
q.7280: I've to go to the marketplace and I can't let people use the forge in my absence. You're going to have to leave.
q.4022: Let me think about it, okay?
q.5122: As'Ruoy'Dnim named me lieutenant-colonel as soon as I arrived! I mean, I don't have any responsibility, but 'lieutenant-colonel Kapp Tenn' sounds pretty good now doesn't it?
q.4511: Ah, bravo! Some supplies? We'll sort out taking him some.
q.6576:
I suppose you know what all this is about already, so I'm not going to beat around the bush. Our militia is terrible, they can't coordinate themselves, and so our tactics are completely useless. We need to find a tactician who can form a link between our strategists and our brainless foot soldiers. 
The Pandala Library is famous for its huge collection of works on military history, including the seminal Art of war in Getas, and War in Pieces. You'll definitely find someone who knows a thing or two about tactics over there.
q.4885: Amayiro needs me? It'll be a pleasure to help him, of course. Tell him I just need a day's notice so I can close the shop and let my customers know.
q.7905:
Greetings, warrior, and welcome to the Gladiatrool!  
If you're looking for epic battles that you won't find anywhere else, you've come to the right place. Together or with an ally, try to complete all 10 of my challenges. I'll even provide the weapons and the tonics! 
 
It'll cost you just one entry token to get in. Before heading into the arena, make sure you've equipped a weapon by standing on one of the twelve slabs.
q.2711: I'm forging a shield for the Pandasiman... He's a Master in the art of shield fighting. He only uses shields blessed by me and his shield was stolen by Pandikazes.
q.2641: Poochan very happy. Poochan give you secret to use source with no side effect.
q.5767:
I can't think for the life of my why that Ronan the Jocker fellow is more talked about than you. It'll cost you 4,000 Kamas to go neutral.
And don't forget, you can join the weaker alignment for free!
q.6303:
I see. So in the end, you don't know a whole lot about the place...
The Well of the Corrupted Souls is a place where wandering should blocked in our world gather to become servants of evil. The wells are a link between our world and another plane of existence where corruption is the accepted way to do business. That's why these wandering should, once trapped in the wells, never come back the same as they went in... and that's when they do come back at all.
q.4598: A good choice. Here's the reward for your loyalty. Tell Amayiro that the spy was being helped by several Brakmarians when you found him and you weren't able to stand up to so many enemies.
q.3899: So, are you going to help us or not?
q.4285: I'm telling you the truth. I'd never betray Bonta. I'm far from perfect, but I'm faithful to the principles that our city is founded on. I swear to you on Jiva's head... I beg of you, don't turn me in... I'll never buy food from the Brakmarians again! I've other suppliers. They're expensive, but I'll buy from them, ok.
q.937: Welcome to the Kikim Inn, what can I do for you ?
q.560: I can propose you to go on a dream island, heaven on earth. Just imagine: lying down on the fine golden sand, your delicate skin getting tanned, the sea breeze on your face. In your hand, a Kokonut milk cocktail. Once you've spent the whole day doing nothing at all, you'll meet your friends and sit at the locals' table. They are skilled cooks and will treat you like a king. In the evening, just admire the magical show of the moon lightning the vast flora and fauna of the place. If you want to entertain yourself with some shivers, agents who have been especially trained for a century will be at your disposal.
q.2826: So, you betray your own to get on in the world, huh?
q.3583: Yes. Me want to be angel to fly to Bonta.
q.3156: Hello #1. I'm Nikos. Nikos Monot. I'm the greatest sailor of all time. I've seen places no other eye has seen, I've gazed beyond the oceans and I've penetrated the giant mystery of the Kralove. As Tina Burner used to say... I'm simply the best.
q.5679:
Recently, a courageous member of the Order of the Valiant Heart delivered the old Enutrof Terra Cogita to us. He's currently in Bagrutte's Inn and holds vital information on the location of Statuettes of Sumen, and we need this information.
The renegades we interrogated revealed the existence of these statuettes that are a symbol of mankind's good and evil. Maimane gave them to Sumens and Brakmar seeks to seize them, so we must act quickly.
q.3765: Excellent work. I'm proud of you!
q.5069: I get the feeling you've come here to bring me something.. something strange.
q.7908:
Couldn't be simpler, my friend! 
For the low cost of just one entry token, you'll get to choose one of the twelve weapons by standing on one of the slabs in the room. Then you'll take on the abilities of that discipline until you leave. 
 
Each time you go in, I'll ask you to leave your equipment at the entrance. It won't give you any characteristics anyhow... Also, just to keep things from getting too crowded, I do stamp everyone's hand and ask them to wait 10 minutes before going back into the arena after leaving.
q.6403:
It's been a long time since we made any of that kind of flour. It's for a funeral, I suppose? I'm very sorry for your loss. Under the circumstances, I'd be happy to give you the recipe. If you take the ingredients to a farmer, they should be able to make it for you - whatever their level.
And don't worry, the soul of your former friend will end up reincarnated one day.
q.6371: Some slightly crazy adventurers have already set off looking for the Fogornleg Horn on Moon Island, and they claim to have seen the guardian. It's well worth noting that they were dressed up as Ambushers and had drunk a bottle of Glutoburg when he appeared to them, which says a lot for the credibility of their story. If I were you, I'd take their advice with a large pinch of salt.
q.2743: Avoid the damned springs. Did you know our goddess only had one single hangover in her whole life, but that it's been lasting for a thousand years? Well, her divine binge made her as sick as a dog, which created the little springs of magic water that flow just round the corner from here in Terrdala and Akwadala. Be careful! This water can imprison the souls of people who fall into it, and trap them in a deadly curse... it's probably the smell that does it. The unlucky victim then takes on the appearance of the last imprisoned soul...
q.5014: Wow, he looks so mad! What he needs is a little rest and relaxation. A little yago would do him the world of good.
q.1020:
I bet some of them will be surprised when they get their next pay.
Thanks #1. I'll give them their badges back myself.
q.6525:
That's beginners luck, well, that or the devil's luck, and I'm tempted to say the latter. I'll reply to your question, that way I'll leave here tonight still with a few Kamas in my pockets. Do you know where the Miners' Market it? Yes, the one in Brakmar, obviously! Petra's hideout is near there, that's all I can tell you, and I don't want to talk to you anymore.
Don't forget your winnings.
q.2983: You don't know it yet but it's your dearest wish.
q.6548:
I don't want to see you again until you bring me the bags I asked for. If you force the issue too much you'll end up in the depths of the giant Kralove's nose.
I don't give a damn that it has no nose! Any other hole will do just as well.
q.4668:
According to a recent report, we're still one step ahead of the Bontarians. Get yourself over to Moon Island and convince Elturt to reveal the location of the Fogornleg Horn, in exchange for the Spentox Back-Scratcher.
Hmmm. Try offering him some Salad laced with pollen, it should calm his mistrust somewhat. We need to keep luck on our side. I'm sending the other militiamen to watch the Bontarians, so don't count on them to help you with this mission.
q.6356: I know that traffickers are operating in this port, I'd bet on your mother's life! Ever since Wabbit and Moon Islands were discovered and the tourist trails have been put in place by the 'A' Tourist Team, illegal activity has flourished. Speaking of illegal, you look pretty dodgy to me yourself. You wouldn't be a diversion by any chance, would you?
q.2190: I don't know what's happening but more and more adventurers come to this city every day. It's getting really stuffy round here.
q.5682:
You're kidding me, aren't you? I just told you that I don't do anything for anyone any more.
Ugh, stop making that face, I'll help you - but it's the last time, understood?
However, you'll need to fetch the ingredients. I need 5 Potions of Old Age, 10 Magical Cure, 3 Edelweiss, 10 Flax Seed, 1 Sunflower Seed and 1 Quetsnakiatl Feather. Think you can manage that?
q.4555: I'd love to help you, but if I do I'll need a favour in return. If you can bring me one of my manuals I'll help you make this bandana ship-shape again.
q.1517: I just want you to think about it. Which cult do you follow? Do you support the destruction of Bonta. Will you help us make good our revenge? Or do you want absolute power and the death of every living thing? Are you an honourable soul? Or are you just like Oto who will ignore all morals to achieve his goals? Your choice is very important. Take this ring. When you have made your decision, come back to me. Give me back the ring if you wish to belong to Djaul's movement.
q.6665: Listen to me carefully, what I'm about to say is for your ears only. No one else can find out because I'm risking my life and you your head, understand? Go and see Oto Mustam, in the Brakmarian Militia, tell him I sent you.
q.6515: Ow! That hurts! You're crazy! And all that because you don't want to take the Kamas from me.
q.3978: Yes, that's for sule! But how can we apploach him?
q.4710: Well, like every morning, I prepared my things and put them in my Gobball-leather bag and the document was not there. I worked my shift near the Farmers' Market until evening. After that I went to the Smiths' Workshop to get a new weapon, then to the Shoemakers' Workshop to change my boots before heading over to Atyu Sirvis' Inn.
q.6349: I knew it. You're only helping me to get what you want. That's not very charitable to be honest, it stinks of fish. I've seen through your Machiavellian scheme... and since I'm just about to test my Dragobutt I'm going to have to ask you to leave!
q.4139:
I knew you didn't have much to do at the moment! 
So, the job I'm offering you is quite simple. I need to heal the Coralators that are walking on the beach. Some strange parasitic molluscs are slowly eating their brains... The only thing that we can do to save them is to give them a Bulbish potion, strong enough to heal the most advanced cerebral wounds. When you get a chance, you should try this potion, it would do you good!! Anyway... Try to find a competent alchemist and bring me back this potion as soon as you can.
q.4616: Excellent work. The Iop needed to dig to find the Fogornleg Horn, and fortunately for us he didn't realise that. Bring it closer to me, please. It's truly a magnificent Horn, it must contain incredible magic powers. It will be the ace up our sleeves in the fight against Brakmar.
q.1393: I caught sight of a man dressed in a blue cloak, running north. Was he a Bontarian fugitive? If so, he picked the wrong way to go - he was heading straight for the Sidimote Gorge were our warriors patrol.
q.4909: Bahhhh.... Baaaaa... Baaaaaa... I said BAAA!
q.6173:
Excellent, you've made the right decision!
Go quickly to Amayiro in the Bontarian Militia and tell him I sent you.
Actually, don't tell anyone else about this little favour as Astrubian militiamen aren't allowed to recruit on behalf of the big cities. It's our little secret, OK?
q.4621: Congratulations on your victory against the Brakmarians. When I think of all the trouble we've gone through to get this Horn... It will teach us not to put our faith in rumours and legends. If it's of any consolation, you can comfort yourself with the fact that thanks to the power of this Horn, there will be fewer young recruits on potato peeling duty. You have served Bonta brilliantly and your loyalty is worth more to me than some magic object.
q.6507:
ahahahahahhaahahah
HAHAHAHAHHARHARHARHHAA!
Give me 1,000 Kamas and I'll tell you why I'm laughing.
Give me 1,500 Kamas and I'll tell you where the hidden gaming rooms are.

HARHARHAHARHARHAAHA!
q.6509:
ahahahahahhaahahah
HAHAHAHAHHARHARHARHHAA!

Hahahhahaaahahaaahaha
HARHARHAHARHARHAAHA!
q.4636: Hello you. Did you find someone to make a back-scratcher? If they're reluctant to help you, tell them to come see me.
q.6508:
ahahahahahhaahahah
HAHAHAHAHHARHARHARHHAA!
I'm laughing because you've just lost 1,000 Kamas.
Hahahhahaaahahaaahaha
HARHARHAHARHARHAAHA!
q.5609: That wasn't everything, but I'm absolutely knackered now, so I'm going to have a little nap - wake me up if you need to.
q.7911:
Oh! I see this is your first time at the arena. Not too nervous, I hope? Remember, the most important thing is to keep your breathing calm and even. 
 
All right, then! Do keep in mind that if you're joined by an ally, it's important that you both take part in the same fights. Otherwise, you won't wind up in the same room afterwards. 
 
Since this is your first try, you'll get an extra little bonus if you manage to make it all the way through.  
 
Good luck!
q.3719: Ahhh, thank you, thank you... the nymphets will be grateful.
q.1207:
Me? Follow you? Sorry but I can't... It's all way too recent...
But take my badge, it should be enough!
q.4551: Yuuummm. Very good this dish is. Some Greenjely added you have? A great chef indubitably are you. However, even with this dish, flattery nowhere will get you.
q.6385: Thewe's one pawt of Eltuwt's body that he can't weach. No, not thewe, I'm talking about his back. I don't know what you want fwom Eltuwt, but now you know that, you have an advantage ovew him.
q.2605: Ah! My bamboo! I'll be able to make many shields thanks to you! Here, this one's for you!
q.988: I see you found blood of the Wabbit GM. Well I need to have this blood analysed. Go ask the enchanter Otomai, he'll be able to do that...
q.4577: I didn't think it would be easy, perhaps I pushed a little too hard. In wanting to beat Brakmar I forgot the essential part. As we were unable to flatter her, we'll take some time to work something else out.
q.3726: Bow down before the almighty Iop, protector of Amakna. Admire his sword, symbol of all his power.
q.6347: As you're so persistent, I'll give you a chance to convince me. I never leave this cave anymore, so it's rare that I meet anyone these days. The loneliness gets to me and... how can I put it... sometimes I'd really love some company, you know? So do you think you could maybe bring me... um... a Dragobutt in Bwork Purple Leather? It would put an end to the loneliness, and while you're there I'll do my best to get the machines working again. Oh, could you also get me some Crab Tongues? Their texture is so nice to the touch. Anyway, I want 10 lovely Crab Tongues and 10 Forked Tongues while you're at it. I need those to test my Robo Whoop machine. It's not for personal use you know! Why are you looking at me like that? What else do you think I'm going to do with a Robo Whoop? And get me 20 planks of Kaliptus Wood. Apparently their resin is a powerful aphrodisiac.... It's none of your business what I'm going to do with them, just get out of here.
q.2927:
I see you know about the existence of elemental tonics... do you know also that only the greatest Pandawushu masters can use them? 
As the Air Pandawushu master, I can provide you with my invigorating breath for your next fights...
q.1294:
You're lucky I had the sun in my eyes... I should have won.
Come back again tomorrow and things won't go so well for you.
q.6180: I won't help anyone who has sullied their honour. Come back and see me when you've made amends for your dishonour.
q.4640:
I'm just doing my job, nothing more. I'm just here on work experience. It was either this or cleaning the toilets at the Trool Fair. I didn't have to think about it for long.
The documents? I gave them back to Larry Poller, in front of the Tower of Bonta, my superior came by and picked them up later.
q.2933:
I see you know about the existence of elemental tonics that only great Pandawushu masters can perform! 
As the Earth Pandawushu master, I can make you become a real force of nature in your next few fights...
q.5453: What rank do you wish to have in the militia?
q.6637: Because I'm telling you that they're as white as the mane of an abominable snowman.
q.6526: I can't find my horn, and it's driving me up the wall. I'm all wound up and I want to smash something. And what's more, that Ecaflip won't stop laughing and it's so very, very annoying! I've a good mind to pull out his whiskers. That'd soon shut him up.
q.6766: I see you coming, I'm not stupid like a sacrificial doll, nor am I crazy, like a Madoll. What I'm is a unique creation of the god Sadida, and several decades after he brought me to life, he gave me the enormous responsibility of watching over this place and guarding it against invaders from a distance. He knew that by giving me this task, he might not ever see me again. It was a huge sacrifice for him to have made. He must have cried for years when I left and to be honest, I don't think he'll ever be the same. It doesn't surprise me, he really enjoyed my company, you know. What a sad story.
q.6826:
You wouldn't do that, would you? Yes, you would?
Okay, I'll tell you what I know, but you must promise not to tell my parents.
One of the Ecaflips who often comes here at night sometimes talks with a Sram. Recognising this Ecaflip isn't difficult: each time he comes here, he prepares himself slices of Farle's Pig. If you arrive early enough you can't miss him, unless he's not there.
q.6179: I'm really sorry but I'm under strict instructions. Categorically forbidden to recruit for the Brakmarian or Bontarian militia. *whispers* I can get around this restriction when someone wants to join the minority alignment, don't forget...
q.6539:
To summarise: you took the money, you exploited the bitch to make her think she was saved and once you'd had your wicked way with her, you killed her. I underestimated just how evil you were. To tell you the truth, it was just a test, a test you passed with flying colours! You actually killed Petra's double, while the real Petra was on her way here to give me a report of your actions. I'm impressed. Continue like that, and you'll go far, I like my second fiddles to be like you. 
One last point: don't even think about going near Petra again, for whatever reason! Have I made myself understood? If you so much as lay a finger on her, or even think about her, I'll force you to swallow a living Miremop.
q.6170:
You're not as stupid as you look, are you. Would you be interested in joining the ranks of the defenders of Brakmar? If so, I can offer you a purse full of Kamas and teach you a few veteran tricks that'll be of great use in a fight.
So, what do you say?
q.1376:
I see, I see...Could you wait a moment please...Ok.
It seems that the magmatic mass is actually moving, but in a totally chaotic way. Therefore, Brakmar has a very small chance of being buried beneath lava. But I'd still like to know what causes these disruptions... I'll stay here for a while. Here is the report you asked for.
q.4041: Bewawe! The monstew is coming back!
q.1596: Bhat bo you want buman ? How bo you bare to bisturb this bame?
q.4666: What are you still doing here? The other militiamen are already attempting to hold off the Bontarians but they won't be able to do so for ever. Hurry up and bring me the Fogornleg Horn.
q.6559: I'd have been fine with it if didn't already have a thousand late orders. I've to forge weapons to slay the Moowolf, to scalp the Bworker and to gut the Minotot, so I really don't have time to equip the militia. I did know another smith a long time ago who mysteriously left for the mountains. I haven't seen him for ten years, so I'm sure he for one won't be snowed under with work. Go see Graham Finame in the south-west workshop, he might remember where the mountain smith is.
q.4625: The horn should be on Moon Island and you have taken the trouble to prepare some Kokonuts for your next mission? Excellent initiative. If only the other militiamen showed such foresight, Bonta would have fallen a long time ago.
q.3906: Come back when you know more about it. I can't do a thing without proof.
q.5819: You again? What do you want this time?
q.5729: I'm sorry, I do not know. And even if I did, I wouldn't tell a stranger.
q.6828: I'm getting rather tired of your story about owls. If you're not here to gamble or to watch these Tofus being slaughtered, there's nothing for you here. So let the honest people have some fun in peace.
q.3945: Ah, you've got the recipe, good! Can you go and collect the ingredients now?
q.4569: The guardian really exists, but he's refusing to co-operate? I hope you weren't sharp with him, it's totally out of the question to use Brakmarian methods. As soon as you've recovered from your journey, I'll have another mission for you. Hurry up and get better.
q.6319: I wouldn't usually say this but the smith who's supplying the militia is completely useless. The only reason he got the job is that his father does business with the attendant. It turns my stomach to think that this incompetent sod, Latem Sa, has been getting so much business. It's just another example of connections speaking louder than competence, and look what the result is. The smith should be in the smith workshop in Astrub... I didn't want him hanging around mine!
q.3428: Blinded by victory, danger can no longer be seen.
q.4603: The ritual was a success. I made a note of the details on a parchment. I've signed and dated it so Amayiro can see it's authentic. Good luck for the next part of your mission, you're going to need it.
q.1444: Ah, everything is finally back to normal! I'm still not grateful, though, you were way too slow!
q.4595: The documents! You were able to get them back, well played! I fear Brakmar are looking for the Fogornleg Horn too, however, or why would they have stolen these documents from us? Whatever the case, we've surely got a head start on them. We must make the most of it.
q.605: Me...? Oh no, I'm afraid of heights but I've already seen other kids doing it.
q.1417:
In that case, you should bring me some Scurvion venom because our stock low... You'll easily find some in the Sidimote Moors.
Bring me 30 pods of it.
q.5728: Ah yes, I heard two sucker... I mean two officers talking about it. They said that the statuette was guarded day and night in the Tower of Orders in Brakmar and that those incompetent Bontarian fools would never be able to recover it.
q.1122: The city I come from is a lot more beautiful but this one is quite charming too.
q.3964: Did you bring me the Kamas or what?
q.2915:
Greetings. I hope you've booted a few Brakmarians around!
What can I do for you?
q.3023: In this case, I can't do anything for you. Your spirit isn't ready. You're not worthy. I'm not even sure you smell nice. Go back to your god, or go see one of his disciples. A Xelor should be able to inform you.
q.3761: Bloody scarecrows, they never stop moving about. They know that young adventurers come here to practice their fighting skills. The inexperienced fighters can't hurt them, so the scarecrows play hide and seek for laughs. I'd be better off with a pitchfork than this big bloody pike here. I'd make a fine haystack out of these straw puppets.
q.6418:
Even during your mission you were thinking of your boss. You deserve a little bonus. As for me, I'm going to give this potion to Sbab.
Why Sbab? It's none of your business, keep your nose out.
q.4472:
Bontarian smiths are not skilled enough to make this type of equipment. That means that Bonta hired a smith to forge all this stuff.
You must find this smith and convince him to work for us.
q.6829:
I once knew someone stickier than you, it was a young jelly that fell in love with the sole of a militiaman's boot. The only way for the militiaman to get rid of it was to kill it with fire. I don't suppose you want to suffer the same fate, though, do you?
Obviously not, so I invite you to go home and let us entertain ourselves in peace.
q.4624: Don't hesitate to use threats if necessary. The tavern keepers are easily convinced.
q.2258: Unlike us Fecas, these stupid creatures aren't known for their intelligence! Well... that's it... a Gobball's gone missing: would you mind looking for it? I think it went over near the underpasses. Go and see Gasdaure, if anyone knows where it is, it's her.
q.129: Bows with magic powers are rare and tricky to make, you often need to combine rare woods with precious metals and stones to make a bow that will be both magical and deadly.
q.1690: Choose the number of Trool Tokens

q.1251: Brakmarian cloaks? Every tailor knows how to make them, 1 Dark Dye, 1 Black Gobbly Wool, 1 Chafer Bone... and it's done!
q.1403: Are you really sure you don't want to obey an order of the steward of Bonta?
q.5504: Brakmarians..! Here..?! If you think you can stop me, fiends, you've got another think coming.
q.3935: Yes, I brought a lot of cawwots from the island... It seems a Wabbit prince is on his way to Amakna.
q.2320: So, you did bring the bow to Dragonsly?
q.3715: Indeed. Pouring their bath water on your wounds will heal them. People from all around come to this magical place to heal their battle scars... I've to fill the basins all the time.

Brakmar? You come from... BRAKMAR?

q.3375: Yes! You have done well young one. I'm impressed... but it's not over yet. Here is the key that will lead you to your next challenge.
q.3575: Yes. I like courageous and powerful warriors. I'm myself quite courageous, I'm not scared of these horrible slimy, creeping, crawling, glistening and dirty creatures prowling around here. I'll personally reward your enthusiasm. Bring it on!
q.6395: To make a back-scratcher, you need to start with an incomplete back-scratcher. One you've got the incomplete back-scratcher, stand in front of the forge and we'll finish it together.
q.6394: To assemble the handle and the tip of the scratcher you'll need a handyman to stand in front of the forge. The handyman will need the following: a Handyman's Hammer, and 2 Ebonite in their inventory, as well as the handle and the tip, obviously.
q.5950: Greeting, young assassin. Has the region of Amakna seen much strife of late?

q.3182:
You're in an incredible labyrinthine library and you may never get out of here alive. 
This library consists of 16 small rooms which all together form a big square-shaped library. If you want to change rooms you must defeat the appropriate group of creatures. Each group will take you to a new room. There are two different groups of creatures. When you defeat a group of creatures (whichever one), they'll take you to the next room as a reward. Warning! Both types of creatures have their own little habits. Each of them always go in the same direction. Therefore you'll have to fight against different groups if don't want to endlessly go round and round.

q.2873:
You can deposit both Kamas and items in your bank account.
You can only have one bank account. 
Every time you access your bank account, even if you're just having a look inside, you must pay a fee.
This fee depends on the number of items stored in your bank account, and the number of items you can store in your bank account is determined by how long you've banked with us. Each person living in the province of Amakna gets a bank account.

So, as time passes by, it will cost you more and more to access your account, as you deposit more items in it. However, the longer you stay with us, the more items you'll be able to put in it.

q.6225:

So anyway, when I was babysitting Xephires' kids, I often happened to overhear conversations about business... but I didn't always understand. Xephires had money trouble before, but within a few short months, all his problems had disappeared and he found himself in a comfortable position in Bontarian society. He sold his house for a bigger model and that's when I decided to take up the family business. 
He has since changed house many times, but he sometimes calls round to visit and to make a few orders.
q.5583:

Their hideout is near the Handyman's Workshop and you often find Ze Krow hanging around there too. They seem to be well organised, so if you're going to pay them a visit make sure you find some Bontarians to go along with you.

AAAH! It's you! Let me warn you: my new partner 'Bawurk', as he calls himself, will give you what's coming to you and that'll be the last I'll see of you.

With some more time, I'll be able to solve the mystery.

Retrace the exact route Kit Dingaround took on the day of his arrest. Go from the Farmers' Market to the Smiths' Workshop, then to the Shoemakers' Workshop and finally to Atyu Sirvis' Inn. Ask all the passersby that you meet along the way if any of them saw anything that day. Once you have additional information or clues, talk to Ture Inge, we need his expert advice.
Go now, I trust you. May Silvosse guide you to the truth.

All the ones I've had so far ran away after half-a-day's work....Tsss they're all chickens! I need some important resources to make my weapons... Of course, I'll pay you.

q.945: Hi! I'm Kosuke the Blade Smith. How can I help you ?

My nose is so itchy. You wouldn't have a flower on you, would you? It smells of Bloomus!

Would you like a sweet... some Eniripsa powder, perhaps? For your pets..? Have any of your pets died lately? Well, I can bring them back to life with one simple sneeze! Easy come, easy go.

What you see over there are the treasures of a lifetime spent hunting and adventuring, and that's only the half of it. 
When you too have lived through as many adventures as I have, you'll want to settle down as well, and that's when the boredom will set in. 
I was a member of the Rogues, defeated the Mega Crackler one on one and beat the Irascible Dragnoute in a flat race. I witnessed the capture of the demon As'Ruoy'Dnim, who terrorised Amakna, I discovered the island of Otomai with my friend Captain Kradoc and I even travelled to Kwismas Island and met Count Harebourg himself.

q.2413:
Professions are divided into two main categories: harvesting and local crafts. Neither category could flourish without the other.
Farmers, lumberjacks, fishermen, hunters and miners harvest raw materials from nature's bounty.
The local craftspeople, including all smiths, sculptors, jewellers, shoemakers and tailors use their skill to refine and craft these materials. 
Alchemy occupies a special place, as its practitioners are both harvesters and crafters at once.

The bewitchment was harmless to plants and animals with one exception, Elm trees. These majestic trees, which up to then had been so numerous, died in their hundreds from the bewitchment, and still the curse grew stronger. A group of Sadidas who were searching for the origin of the curse tracked the Bwork Mage to his lair and there they revisited one hundred fold the suffering he caused to the Elms. The tub should be heated throughout the ritual, one person should dedicate themselves to this task. Only Hornbeam Wood can be used.
To activate the magic breeze, use 4 Draught Potions. Again, one person should dedicate themselves to this task.
