Only a few demons still respect the ancient code. I can understand your situation, if you want to keep your honour intact, I can lie about the fact that you brought me these ears.
q.1303:
Well, let's make a deal. You'll have to kill someone for me, for 10,000 Kamas. A certain Rimaraf. He lives in the South-West of the city. He's a high-ranking militiaman, not a bad guy but he overshadows me. I'd like you to break into his house and bring him a poisoned dessert. 
He has a weakness for cakes, so he will inevitably eat this poisoned Rasputin Cake! 
You'll have to ask a baker to make you this cake plus find the poison.
q.3491: Me headache, *yawns and rubs his head* Me search mummy.
q.1345:
You want to play Rock, Paper, Scissors with me? ME? You cheeky monkey, don't you know I'm the champion of Amakna? Anyhow, I only play for money... okay?
We'll play three rounds, 10 Kamas a round... and you can stop whenever you want..
You must win the 3 rounds to win the game.
q.1338:
You're lucky, I've a disenchantment potion right here.
Now Colonel, there you go, you look much better.
q.1454: Phew! That's better. I forgive you. It's true that he's precocious... just like his dad. Anyway. We're out of firewood...and guess what? It's up to you! Bring us 10 Treechnid barks. Here, take this note as a reminder... You don't want to forget the order again, do you?
q.6366: I see. The Bontarians have been playing us for fools. You were looking for their ship and all along they were transporting their equipment by land. That makes sense given what we've been hearing lately.
q.5675: Greetings. Did you show the renegades what's what?
q.3916: I think I heard people talk about a prince coming from the far away land of Wa. I had never heard about this country before and no, I don't know where you can find him.
q.5147: What? Don't take that holier-than-thou attitude when you look at me, it doesn't suit your terrible dress sense.
q.2066: You see, I can't leave my little girl alone while I'm away. And she can't come with me either, she'd only disturb everyone, including me! I've a favour to ask you. Can you look after her for a few minutes. I won't be long...
q.2095: Well, well...that's a special girl, and we can see who she's taking after. I've one last favour to ask you. With all this fuss, some of our Gobballs have escaped. Some got lost near the underpasses.
q.2709: A secret meeting is being held at this very moment in Aerdala. We don't know anything about what's going on over there... But we do know one thing: it's about the Dofus. The wise Lenald wishes to send you over there, as it's difficult to trust any of us at the moment, since Pandikazes are everywhere. But Lenald really thinks he can trust you. Be careful: many adventurers were given a cold welcome in Aerdala! Some say they're allied to the rebel Pandawas - those who sabotaged all the access roads of the island. You must infiltrate the enemy clan and report to us as much information as you can. Go see the wise... if you come back alive.
q.2789: Well done. Let's get out of here! Now we split to confuse the issue. Good luck!
q.3114: Poor boy, he doesn't want to leave the jail even though King Allister pardoned him. He stole a whole convoy of potatoes fwom Wabbit Island.
q.4631: Find out more about Elturt, it's the only way of discovering his weak spot.
q.3280:
Silvosse seems to be with you... You're cured! The curse is coming out of you...
What a pity! You were such a nice Treechnid!

If I were you, I wouldn't waste my time and I'd try to get out of this dungeon while I still can.
q.3518: Me want to eat your heart, not mine!
q.5492:
Good day.
To strengthen the links between Pandawas and the other races of the World of Twelve, the goddess Pandawa has decided that newly incarnated souls should now appear at the foot of the recently erected statue in the city of Astrub. This is good news, don't you think?
q.2289: I think Osamodas masters know a lot about these creatures. I don't know any masters personally, though...
q.3337: I'm glad to see you my good friend! I knew we would work together again. Perhaps we can become partners, you and I. You can wander about the countryside, as I know you like to, and I, I'll create all sorts of things... Yes, wandering around the countryside... I know you like that! Yes, well, here is the list. I can't wait for you to return... I... I miss you already... I should stop... okay. Farewell, friend.
q.5510:
Great to see you! The Brakmarians are getting more and more violent, but happily Bonta can count on valiant fellows like yourself. 
Silvosse is watching over you.
q.3141: I think that if the four sisters agree to lent you their brooch, it's because they trust you and you deserve to go through this door! Borrow their brooches and come back see me if you dare!
q.3440: Children? No, I haven't seen any children for a long time. And yet, I love children, I love them a lot...
q.3721: I'm going to turn into a bloody bucket myself if I keep on carrying all this water!
q.3453: What's this strange dish... hmm, it's quite tasty... *crunch*, *yummm*, *slurp*, *buuuuuuuuuuurp*, delissshious! I haven't eaten that well since ... well, I can't even remember eating something that delicious in my whole life. I'll keep my promise but I don't want to see them around here ever again.
q.1474: I told you we would be 10 for dinner tonight. So go get at least 10 carcasses! Right now!
q.5619: Hahaha, you think we're going to start talking? We know all of Bonta's methods of interrogation and we're not going to tell you a thing. Why don't you go try and get some information out of your mother.
q.351: I urgently need a Staff made of Treechnid Roots for my friend Farle Ingalsse who needs it to herd his Gobball Flocks... If you could call on a good Staff Carver who can make you one, and if you could bring it back to me, I'll give you a very rare resource: a Worked Sap of Treechnid.
q.3464: Brewing Bwork Beer or breeding Bworks... Which job will bring me the most Kamas with the least effort?
q.5351: I want you to find out about Divad Dleifrepok for me. I think he might be hiding something from me. Follow him discreetly and question him when the time comes. Be careful... and remember he's a first class illusionist.
q.4483:
I want you to intercept the weapons convoy before it reaches the Imp village, so what are you still doing here?
If you're here to tell me you have the booty, I already told you to bring it to Stampitor on the upper floor.
q.1509:
I wanted to meet you, young disciple of Oto Mustam. You've performed quite a few astonishing feats for Brakmar lately. And it's inscribed in the darkness that it won't stop here.
But you don't know EVERYTHING about Brakmar just yet. This vision could change the way you see Brakmar.
Do you want to hear it ?
q.1058:
I warned you, you must know when to stop! 
Anyway I'm in a good mood today. So just try again.
q.1390: I was surprised by a Bontarian and got knocked out. I couldn't see his face because of the darkness, what a shame... by Djaul! We can see his tracks going Westward. I hope he hasn't gone too far.
q.4817: I was wondering about this famous horn of Bonta. If it's so powerful, why haven't they attacked yet? I think they're hiding something. Go and find Finche Aticus, the spy in Bonta, and ask him if he has any news.
q.4527: I was waiting. I've another mission for you if you're interested. And let me tell you, I'll pay you better than Amayiro will ever do...
q.3409: You can't to see the turnip pile for the turnips, step back from the canvas, child.
q.4855:
I knew I could count on you. Bonta doesn't stand for traitors, you did as you had to do.
Here, take this for your trouble.
q.9897: Well, remember that until the fragment has been charged, I won't be able to trade it to you for another one. Are you sure of your choice?
q.167: I'll never exchange mine for all the tea in Sufokia, except for even more powerful decks. If you're looking for decks of cards, speak to people who like to play Tragic the Gardening, you'll certainly meet some of them as you travel. They may agree to exchange some cards with you.
q.761: I won't have any mission to give you for a little while #1. Come back for the next update of our staff...
q.6264: I'll do what's necessary the next time a Bontarian comes round this way, but it'll cost you 2,000 Kamas.
q.2091: I'd like to teach her the art of magic. But, you see, I don't really have the time. I think you would make a great teacher. Teach her everything you know, it will be very good training for her, won't it Allisteria? *She doesn't answer*
q.4829: I maintain that there's no reason for me to be here. I have nothing to do with it. I'm an honest Sram.
q.3594: I'd be happy to help you find some work, but you can earn a lot more Kamas down in Amakna. It might be time for you to leave Incarnam.
q.4218: I wrote several books on this island and I read many books on this lost civilization. Unfortunately, we can no longer find them in libraries. Some authorities believe that books are dangerous, questioning the power of some gods and trying to explain things that shouldn't be known.
q.2016: I'd like to know what those Xelors get up to with this Epyss Grain. I don't know why it's so rare, they're the only ones who use the damn stuff! It's tasteless and, short of some magical encouragement, it's impossible to get a drop of oil out of it. I'll tell you one thing, though... this plant grows deep in the heart of a volcano not far from here... usually such an environment would make it highly volatile.
q.5633: I'd watch out if I were you - you really shouldn't stray too far outside Astrub... it's far too dangerous.
q.4121:
Ahem... I don't know... I... I don't know the answer to that question! You got me. I've lost at my own game. I'm a joke. I'm even stupider than you. I didn't think it was possible. Please... Please don't tell anyone that you defeated the Death Bridge Keeper and his questions, I'm begging you...
I'll let you cross the bridge whenever you wish.
q.3897: Good morning, faithful servant! I need your help. Can you do me a favour? you'll be rewarded for your efforts.
q.4810: I'll do it quickly. Oto doesn't like people taking up too much of his time - once you have the leaves, bring them to me so I can modify them too.
q.1247: Nice to meet you, what can I do for you? If you're looking for bread or brioches, you've come to the right place!
q.4152: That's perfect! I'll be able to mix all these flours and with a bit of luck, no one will ever notice.
q.6230: A Sram? No, I haven't seen a Sram around here. I did see one when I was captured though.
q.4893: Those cursed Brakmarians have benefited from our domestic concerns to vandalise our workshops and steal several magic items. Go and see Ebru Of El in the Tower of Bonta, he could do with your help.
q.752: I'll soon need you again. Keep on practicing to be in shape when the time comes.
q.4430: I'll take a closer look at that, there's no point in staying around here. Take a look in Sufokia and see if I'm there.
q.4833: I really can't see what more I can add to my statement... but I suppose that's the procedure.
q.4169:
I'm determined to have the fastest tamed Scaraleaves but for that I'd need to be able to ride them without slowing them down.
That's why I'd need a specific equipment and not this stupid helmet and wooden pair of wings which only enable me to crush down if I fall off my Scaraleaf and uselessly weigh down my means of transport.
I need an improved pilot helmet and cape. Do you think you could get this for me? You'll probably need to find an experienced tailor.
q.4776: I want to know how that witness knew about a confidential document in Kit Dingaround's bag.
q.4181:
Well, you're one of the most courageous adventurers I've ever met. I haven't seen anyone killing creatures that fierce in such a short time for ages. 
I'll talk to Otomai next time I'll see him. He'll certainly be happy to know that you helped one of his oldest friends.
q.5035:
A Dreggon symbol? Is this the best you could find?
Hmm, you could have tried harder, no?
Well too bad, I'll just have to make do with this.
q.4227: Tremble, mortals. This monster existed before the island, it's the island. None can equal its power - Otomai with his fancy spells will not be the first. I've heard of his terrible creation and I don't believe a word.
q.2030: I'm a bit short on potions lately, a lot of people ask me for them... ahem! Anyway, what can I do for you?
q.4860: I'm happy with the way things have gone. Kit really owes you one. Here, have this from him and me. I think you've deserved it.
q.935: Hello, I'm the owner of the Goldenring Jewellery. What can I do for you?
q.1313: I'm bored stiff! I've spent the whole night and day just staring at this jewellery. I can't remember the last time something happened. It's getting harder and harder to keep my eyes open.
q.1335:
I'm both exhausted and proud to have trashed Brakmar.
My men are celebrating our victory but I'm going to get some sleep.
q.3377: I'm impressed but it's not over yet. Here is the key that will lead you to your next fight.
q.2649: I'm getting ready and I'll be right there! Wait for me at the Dojo, you, blue Larva!
q.3278:
I'm enthralled with your victory over the Soft Oak, that mythical creature has lived through tempests without being uprooted and autumns without losing a leaf...

How did a mere, incapable mortal like you manage to bring down such an imposing and powerful creature? Mother Nature really is surprising sometimes.
q.4723: Bring this iron to Mulic quick, I'll have enough trouble 'convincing' him to reforge cursed iron.
q.4239: I haven't got the time to repair your shield, but for the moment I'll give you this one in return for a broken shield of your own. I trade all models!
q.379:
Hello! I'm trying to make the biggest mushroom and seed fritter ever seen for the next feast in honour of Skippy The Guru. Could you help me look for some ingredients?
If you bring me 90 Mushrooms, 70 Sunflower seeds and 40 Hemp seeds, I'll give you a Great Wisdom Scroll in return.
q.4532:
You managed to get into their militia building and steal this document? Excellent. Let's see what's in here...
We don't have the time to read it carefully, every minute counts, so we have to act quickly. I'm going to send men to the Cemetery of the Tortured and you'll go with them. When you've finished with the Brakmarian patrol, come back and report to me. Now get out of here, you mustn't miss the patrol.
q.1774: These scissors are yours from now on... Make good use of them.
q.3305: I'm glad to see that young adventurers like you find time to go to the library now and then. You know, before, there were lots of shops and workshops here. But when the Dragoturkeys arrived, shopkeepers started breeding! It's a lot more profitable! The sale of all the shops financed the construction of all these paddocks and our wonderful library.
q.2076: I'm going to teach you how to shoot... with a bow. Nice reward, huh? But before we start, you need a bow! I don't have enough time, but Ticra will help you. You'll see, she's almost as handy as I'm... almost...
q.6336:
I'm going to put that into practice right away. I need a volunteer to tame the Whitish Fangs.
No! Not you. I've had enough of seeing you round here, and besides, the Whitish Fangs could swallow you whole before you so much as house train them. You may leave.
q.5550:
It's frightening what they give you in this prison. I'd rather eat Shin Larva vomit... in fact I've and it was a lot tastier. Did Brakmar hire a Bwork for a cook?
Don't just sit there, do some cleaning... look, grab that broom over there and get this bloody prison cleaned up.
q.4747: I haven't got any left, the entrance to my cellar is blocked by rocks. If you can get into the cellar, you can help yourself. I'll give you the map and the instructions.
q.5120: As'Ruoy'Dnim didn't increase the effort as I asked. All the same, there's a lot more blood and carnage than before, so I'm happy, I'm getting used to it!
q.2038:
I'm impressed, very impressed. The old Enutrof was wise to keep his secrets close to his chest... It was some stroke of luck you finding that combination... Would you be interested in combining your luck and my intelligence?
The second cave mentioned in this book is south of the Zaap of Amakna. Try to have a look inside!
q.5778:
Now you know what's what, You're ready to play. So you'll need two teams of five players and one victim to play the Gobball. Failing this, a summoned Gobball will do the trick. 
By the way, the rules I've explained to you aren't exactly written in stone... there's no such thing as the Amaknan Gobball Federation or anything! Decide among yourselves, and enjoy the game!
q.4084: Ahem, according to your constitution, I can tell that I'll need a Great Coralator relic to prepare your potion. Once ground to powder, I'll be able to withdraw all the magic power I need from it.
q.6246:
Ah, here's the sheet of paper. Now let's get that combination...
Ah seriously though, who do you take me for, some kind of Bontarian? Did you really think I was just going to hand over the jewel like that because you come here making some noise? Since it's Oto Mustam who's asking, I'll make you a new jewel, though. I'll make a list of all the materials you need for you to bring to your boss.
q.7552:
Me? I was sent here by Grandapan in person.
It's sad but a strange illness has struck the village of Pandala. The variety of drinks on the island is threatened as more and more Pandawas will not drink more than a single drink in one sitting. After a lengthy investigation, we discovered that this illness appeared a few weeks after the erection of the statue, which caused the goddess to explode with rage. That explains my presence here.
Anyway, since you just arrived, I advise you be careful and if you discover anything that could be related to the strange illness which I've just mentioned, let me know.
q.5220: Greetings. I'm sorry, but I have no time at the moment. Come back another time.
q.4803: Ture Inge is finding it very difficult to make Gnirreh talk. I hope he's able to before the trial begins.
q.5762: Has Milone Corichel prepared a present for my mother?
q.4564:
Are you off your trolley? Not here, that would be madness. You want to make people suspicious of the Grandapan or what? All the same I did tell Xephires that I'd get in touch with him to sort out the time and place of the meeting.
I hope for your sake that they're all inside. I can't be sure as long as Grandapan is watching us, but if some is missing, Xephires will know about it!
q.1947: *Sigh* Believe me or not, I don't water the lager down because I'm stingy. I just have no choice. I have less and less beer in stock and I'm still waiting for the next delivery. No beer means no customers, and with no customers, the tavern will close down, which means no more Tek. *sigh*
q.4463: Another Brakmarian no-hoper? You want to take me on too?
q.5011: This judge again? And you say you know people in high places? I'll think about it.
q.4645: Ah, a Brakmarian ally. These bloody archers really got me... quick, we have to get back to Brakmar before they catch up with us.
q.4384: Amayiro sent you to find the jewel? That's very strange, a Xelor just came with a letter telling me to give it to the next customer. Well, here you go, take the jewel.
q.4379: Don't stay here. Go back and see your chief.
q.3827: Hey, I remember you. You already came here, right? You got your reward buddy, I got nothing else for you. This booty's for the novices who still need the practice.
q.2713: And all those adventurers infesting our island will soon be sick with the McSheth!... Huh? We have visitors?! A new Pandikaze recruit it seems...
q.2087: Bloody Enutrofs! It's hard to believe we're actually helping them in their research... Well, we have quite a situation here, don't we - they stay underground so long that they get sick. And then who do you think they give their germs to when they come out?! Our Tofus, of course! I don't know how to cure a damned Enutrof cold... Ahh, my poor Tofus... Thank the gods the Eniripsas are here...
q.5089: Bonta really is an exciting city. You can find all sorts of little jobs that the so-called defenders refuse because they're too scandalous. They're a bunch of hypocrites if you ask me.
q.5781: Glory to Djaul and to Rushu, his master!
q.2942: I'm impressed. Adventurers hardly ever stand up to my headbutts. As a reward, I give you my pet, this adorable black Bow Wow.
q.7549: An excellent fight, but I think you're capable of facing a more formidable opponent. Go to the next platform and defeat the enemy you find there.
q.5427: I know you're not here to take over from me. So why are you here?
q.3318: I'm looking for big, aggressive Dragoturkeys to knock over the Bontarian rank and file.
q.1071: I'm on patrol, you're bothering me. Get outta here!
q.3024: Hello you, stranger. You're at this one special point of the World where the Infinite and the Void join, if these figures are to be believed. It doesn't look like it, does it? Did Nistracolamus send you?
q.6581: Hello. How is the search for a decent tactician going? We have to improve the efficiency of our militia on the ground.
q.6084: I'm not fooled by Djaul's scheme, as before he's trying to pass Jiva off for something she's not.
q.1840:
Hey! Wipe that grin off your face... the end of the world is coming... Gods are enraged! We've uncovered... things from the past... We're damned! All of us! Finished!
Must build a shelter... get underground! Explosions are on their way. Help me... or you'll die too!
q.6292: By Djaul, I'm almost disappointed. If you continue being so dishonest, you might get yourself promoted. Watch out!
q.6071: This Assemble would be a complete waste of time if it wasn't for the false accusations against me.
q.4494: I'm afraid this defeat will incite the Brakmarians to launch an offensive. We have to find a solution. Don't blame yourself, the enemy's equipment made all the difference.
q.1227:
I've never seen blood like it... It's been genetically modified... a lot.
Anyway, here is my analysis, as you requested.
q.589: If you dawdle on the way, you could end up in a stew. I've no doubt that a foodstuff as skilled as you would be too difficult for my worshippers to chew and digest, and it wouldn't be fair on them if I were to put them through it. That said, if we didn't have a decent amount of tender meat stocked up, I'd think about it! Anyway, I can help you leave the village very quickly, if that's what you want. Whatever the case, goodbye!
q.3704: I'm protecting the last Elm of Incarnam. No one can cut it down. The one who dares to try will be attacked by a protector... or even by Sadida himself!
q.4265: So? Did you find anything of interest?
q.5922: A nasty aura and a twisted spirit, who else could it be but you? Did you manage to get a confession from a Bontarian spy?
q.4355:
Ecaflip travellers? Nope, haven't seen any recently. Although I just employed a pretty young Ecaflip, if you're interested in that.
You're on the job? Well, another time then, I wouldn't want to cross Amayiro...
q.5196: Let us pass, we'll bring that roguish Goblin all the way to Bonta.
q.4495:
Justfa Lafs came to see me. He was beside himself. We have to resolve the problem of our militia's equipment right away. I want you to find the smith who makes this equipment and put him to the test. We have to find out who's responsible for such low quality. Start by asking Kosuke Ichazum... I doubt it that he's been doing such low-standard work. 
For the test, I want you to ask him to make a weapon with the following resources: 10 Maple Wood, 2 Ash Wood and 1 Pyrute.
q.4315: A message from Oto? Thieves who are going to steal into my house? Ah! I can hear footsteps!
q.3577: Not bad, not bad at all... You're almost as courageous as I am. Okay, here you go, a little bonus.
q.5022:
A letter for me? Thank you.
*Reads it carefully, them blushes*
My tabi, non... I'll do anything to keep him from getting hurt.
q.4272: An important Bontarian? You won't find that kind of information around here, let me tell you!
q.5530:
A delay in the treason case? Hmm, hmmm... *hic*
I hate investigations that drag on, but since you seem like a decent girl, I'll do what you *hic* ask in exchange for a little favour from you.
I need alcohol to make the prisoners talk but the reserves have run out. *hic* I need a barrel of Shambrosia to continue with the questioning, only Gordo McRamsay in Amakna knows the secret. Oh, and while you're here, I'm looking for an Astrub woman too, but marriage agencies aren't what they used to be. It would be great if you could handle it instead. Unless you're looking for a husband, of course, and then you won't have to *hic* look very far.
q.6428: And what about the others? Well if they don't go making trouble and pay their check, there'll be no problem. These are all experienced fellows, mind you... nothing like what you find in the Feubuk Inn.
q.5374: So? Did you find what you were looking for?
q.1984: Thanks a million! The missing ingredient is a rare flower. It's all white, I think you can find it east of here. When you find it, please bring it to Dragonsly the alchemist!
q.2500: Don't even think you can talk to a Pandawa if you haven't paid the McSheth levy.
q.4807: Thank *hic* you so much. I'm so glad I can count on you *hic*. Go tell Amayiro that the trial can start *hic*.
q.4969: I was told of the existence of a certain symbol which is currently in the possession of the Dreggons. As luck would have it, I need one just like theirs for the temple. I have thought of a way for you to get it. You're going to disguise yourself as a Dreggon and just ask them for it! Well, what are you waiting for?!
q.5593: Good day to you, fellow Brakmarian. These Bontarians are driving me crazy with their Utopian babble.
q.3240: The wise men of this World say that this Dreggon invasion was just a divine punishment. Since Dreggons were already trapped in the sanctuary of this island, all Osamodas did was free them. It's said that the inhabitants of the village had forgotten what their ancestors had done to the Dreggons and that their village had been built on the Dreggon Sanctuary to conceal its existence as if they had wanted to hide to the god Osamodas their wrongdoings and their madness.
q.3737: Even harvesters can craft some basic items. It gives them a bit of experience in their profession.
q.6312: I'm very tempted *hic*, but I'm on duty for the next twenty-four hours. It seems I'm drinking at work too... *hic*... can you believe that!?
q.2555: There's a secret meeting being held in Aerdala this very minute. We've no idea what's going on over there... What we do know is that it has something to do with the Dofus...
q.5870: Greetings. The air around you is dripping with evil. That's great! Have you got a particular reason for being here?
q.5569: Greetings. Have you found Erzal's Blessing?
q.5176: Greetings. Did you get the artefact back?
q.5838: Greetings. Don't worry, you're not disturbing me at all. What can I do for you?
q.6119: Greetings. It's a goood thing the Assembly didn't end in a bloodbath. I'm waiting for you report.
q.4339: I accept your conditions. Don't stay here, you could be ambushed.
q.5261: Very well. We'll have a good advantage if we manage to gain control of these territories, all the Zaaps will be ours.
q.7132: Make sure you're ready before you go fighting a Dopple. So, are you all set?
q.36: Woohoo! I'm so pleased someone's come to visit me! It's not often I've company in this part of Amakna. In fact, I'm so pleased, I'll answer your questions, no matter how stupid they are.
q.6168: I'm sorry... I realise you're enthusiastic, but you're just not experienced enough to come and help me. I'll wait till you're a bit better travelled until I give you something to do.
q.6309: Excellent work. Thanks to you and that imbecile Xephires I'll soon be very rich. Take this purse of money and this food - there's no need to thank me, I'll be making enough money off you, don't worry. Hahaha. As for Xephires, he'd better find out which of the convoys are the good ones. I don't want to end up with mountains of potatoes on my hands.
q.1329: I'm so pleased! Demons are not all idiots, I knew it! Always keep your honour! It could be an honourable war if everyone was acting like you do. Ok, I'm going to shout from the rooftops. Clear off now!
q.2803: You're about to enter the Village of Akwadala. Only those who have proven their strength can go through.
q.3640: You're a smart little larva, aren't you? Yeah, you're a comedian, huh? Well listen to me. Until the day you earn my respect, you're nothing but a larva. You're the lowest form of life on Earth. You're not even human! Now get out of here before I really get mad.
q.3630: Me no want to go with you. Me prefer Piwi feather to Gobrator.
q.4881: Hmm, it's true... Ok, this is how we'll do it. Get stuck into that dirty little pig and then tell me you've lost. I'll act as if it happened like that...

The second potion allows you to reset your characteristics to 101, if you don't want to lose anything you've gained through scrolls.
If you use it, any characteristic above the value 101 will be reset to 101, and you'll get back the appropriate number of characteristic points. A characteristic below the value 101 will not be affected.

I'll try to put your bones together again, keep on concentrating...
How weird! Your heart's on the left and your liver's on the right.... It's supposed to be the other way around... Hum... Ouch... Here you go! I put everything I could back in place... q.6661: The main drawbacks of being aligned are related to aggression. If you're aligned and a militiaman of the opposing alignment attacks you, you'll no longer have the protection of guards if you're in a neutral area. Another large drawback is that the guards of opposing cities will attack you if pass too close to them and they see you. This is particularly troublesome if you want to access workshops and markets. Finally, when you're aligned and you're beaten by a militiaman or a guard of an enemy alignment, you might find yourself in jail. It's also impossible to use Zaaps to access areas belonging to an enemy alignment. I strongly advise you to think carefully before choosing an alignment, as it's not something you should take lightly. In the meantime, go earn your spurs and come back and see me when you have more experience, I may have a tip for you.

q.5777:
There are three main rules you must remember to play this game. First of all, the Gobball must not die! If one team kills a Gobball, no matter whether it's by accident or on purpose, the player's team will be disqualified. 
Apart from that, nearly everything is allowed, but if you kill someone on the other team, you'll have to leave the game. Trainers and substitutes have places by the field and a maximum of five players per team can be on the field at any one time. You can however change places with a substitute. 
Oh and by the way, anyone who's not on the field of play must keep out of the game!

To access the divine pantheon, Sacrier had to pass a test imposed by Ruhsu, the Lord of Demons. Taking Xelor's Clock in her hands, she felt the pain of the world and could not restrain her tears, which fell on the Clock and infiltrated into the workings of time itself. Upsetting the ages, the tears brought about the resurgence of the cities of Bonta and Brakmar, which were no more than dust long ago, and so the goddess Sacrier gave them a second chance.
One of her tears fell to earth in an arid and corrupt area south-west of Brakmar, and it is claimed that life and nature are struggling to take hold there. I'll show you where this place is supposed to be.

What happened then? Well, some brave adventurers (and a lot of idiots too) stood against the two monsters without success. 
It wasn't until the 24 Novamaire 639, that a group of warriors, summoned by Shika Ingalsse herself, managed to defeat the dragons for the first time. 
Grozilla and Grasmera did not go down easily, however, and so adventurers from all walks of life came to the warriors' aid. 
Once the dragons' real motivation was known, the warriors of Shika were followed by the worshipers of the dark Demon Lord Rushu, who in turn were followed by the disciples of Rykke-Errel and the servants of Djaul. Not wanting to be outdone, the servants of the Sage Jiva also defeated the formidable creatures. 
Weakened by the many battles, Grozilla and Grasmera had no choice but to return to the Sanctuary after being repeatedly defeated by the servants of the other patrons of the months and various dignitaries.

She evaluates recruits of a certain rank to see just how evil they are. You've got a long way to go, mercy is a fault that I'll not tolerate. You've done well up to now so forget what little moral values you have left if you wish to climb the higher echelons of our militia.

If you need more information, join me in my special forge and we can talk about it without being disturbed.
q.6730: Hmmm, that rings a bell. I hear customers talk about it from time to time but they were drunk as skunks so I didn't pay any attention to them. Ask Laura Soho, the other waitress. I don't suppose she knows any more than I do but it costs nothing to ask.
q.4610: Greetings, I was just about to call for you. We must profit from our advantage over Brakmar and get our hands on the Fogornleg Horn before they do. I want you to head over to Moon Island immediately and ask Elturt for the Fogornleg Horn in exchange for his bandana. Don't hang about.
q.6370:
Never interrupt me. Be silent and listen to the end, we are not in a tavern, but in a library.
Where was I? Ah yes.
A few years later, the Fogornleg Horn resurfaced when Moon used it to colonise the island that bears his name. After establishing his authority, the monkey no longer needed the powers of the Fogornleg Horn and abandoned it. Thus it disappeared and now rumours, each more far-fetched than the last, circulate in the Taverns about the horn and its possible location, but I don't believe in these pub tales. Actually, you should go talk in such a place, the Amakna tavern is almost as noisy as you are.
q.4534: A Sadida in Astrub told you about a magic horn in Sufokia? It's worth verifying that story. Head over there and talk to the keeper of the Ripate Inn, rumours abound in taverns.
q.6668: I didn't think you looked familiar. Thank Snori Nairb for me, and for Danathor. Come back and see me afterwards, I've some work for you.
q.3958: Okay, you've got the Tofu? What!? It's just a baby! You idiot! It will never be strong enough to kill the prince! Go see a breeder and try to get something to fatten it up quickly. Hurry!
q.4599:
Hello, following the theft of the documents by the Brakmarians I asked Ebru Of El send one of his spies to Brakmar. He was supposed to retrieve the information obtained by Brakmar about the Fogornleg Horn to give us an advantage over them but I'm worried because he's not back yet. Go find him, here's a copy of the mission he was given. Be quick, I fear it's already too late.
If by chance you arrive in time, look for a way to send the Brakmarians on a wild goose chase. May Silvosse watch over you.
q.4571: The Foghornleg Horn. Where it is I know. Reveal it to you I will not. Insist you should not.
q.6417: OK, for 1,000 Kamas, but you drive a hard bargain. And don't come moaning to me if it doesn't work.
q.4560:
So there you have it - the horn is on... an island. Funny, isn't it...
I don't know any more, I'm not a walking library like Harry Stote.
q.4683: The equipment in these crates is poor... but it's better than what they have at the moment.
q.4644: What are you waiting for? Bonta cannot get hold of those documents!
q.4575: You must find a way to sweeten up the turtle. Head over to the island and ask the inhabitants for more information, hopefully someone will be able to help you. As soon as you have the information, try and coax Elturt then come back here with the Fogornleg Horn if you can.
q.5452:
Hello! The goddess Eniripsa has given me the power to help young souls fix the mistakes of their youth.
When you no longer have access to Incarnam, the only way you'll be able to unlearn a spell or reallocate your characteristic points is by fighting Dopples in a class temple or seeking aid from Otomai, the famous alchemist.
Be careful, though! You can only change your characteristics once by fighting Dopples. Only Otomai knows the way to repeatedly change the characteristics of an experienced soul.
q.4884: Orders are orders, I'll be ready when needed.
q.6175: As you seem more enthusiastic than the usual lice, I'll let you off the chore of having to equip my blokes for training. However, as a bit of a smoke-screen, I want you to head to the Amakna militia to pick up an Alignment Conversion Certificate.
q.4617:
We have the horn, but...
I still don't have the slightest idea how to use it!
Nothing seems to happen when I blow it.
You'll have to go ask Magus Ax about it, he's in Astrub and he'll know all about it.
q.6416:
I see, you come from Brakmar and you think you have all the rights in our city? Well, let me tell you that you can shove your finger up your... no, don't do it for real, it's just an expression, an image, you see? Ooof, you've Iop blood in your veins, that's for sure.
I don't usually work for the enemy but if I don't help you, you'll go see one of my competitors and once again Mister Elliaz de Ciwillekh will get all the credit, so I say no!
What you need again? Ah yes, you want to know how to make a Longevity Potion. 5,000 Kamas and the recipe is yours.
q.9649: Well, first you have to stand in front of me, because you're not going to play on the floor, are you?
q.2053: Here you go! Two strokes of a pair of bellows and your blade is forged. Go and see the alchemist and ask him to dip it in his Moon Water on my behalf, it will make your blade all the more solid.
q.4643:
Watch out, creep, your mission is very precise. One of our spies stole some documents from Bonta, but he injured his leg as he was escaping. You have to collect the documents he's carrying. Don't worry about what happens to him once you've got what you need.
He escaped by the road, but he surely hasn't got far.
And hurry up, they may find him soon.
q.4681: Hmm, I'd give this crate back to Oto and tell him what I think of him, but he'd probably promote me for insubordination, and that's the last thing I want.
q.2576: You undelstood: the Dofus nevel left Pandala... All this time, it's been on this island. A white Dofus, still immaculate, that no one had touched fol ages... I hid it inside the dungeon on the peninsula, nolth-east of Pandala. And the Pandikazes, those gangstels, sabotaged the blidge... When I saw Dalk Vlad had a Dofus, I thought he had stolen that one.
q.9646: *These cards' effect lets you draw a "Dofus" card from your deck if all three are on the field.*
q.100: Hi, I'm Rish Claymore, a respected Master-at-arms in Amakna. If you're looking for a Whetstone you're in luck, I've one for sale.
q.3766: Welcome, #1. Incarnating at the foot of your god's statue is a blessing. If you're eager for adventure, I suggest you visit Incarnam before heading to the continent. If you're feeling intimidated, I can take you to the cradle of Tainela. There, Ganymede will teach you the basics of fighting and give you good advice.
q.9643: Nice try, but you fell into my trap: you activated my face-down "Truce" card. No creatures can be killed until your turn ends.
q.7673: *You notice, with amusement, the remains of an overly curious adventurer who went into the wrong cave while trying to uncover an age-old mystery. The bones are covered in footprints and grey hairs...*
q.7674: *Even though the chest is inanimate, you truly feel like it is staring straight at you.*
q.7675: *Even though the chest is inanimate, you truly feel like it is staring straight at you.*
q.7676: *Even though the chest is inanimate, you truly feel like it is staring straight at you.*
q.9612:
Hello, I'm Gladiatrade! 
 
Come and trade your gladiokens for packs of cards and other items. I'll give you the mate's rate. 
 
You can also trade medals for my more prestigious stock, but only one of each!
q.7681:
I can't let you leave with that – it's far too dangerous. I strongly recommend you give them to me. Their power could gradually corrupt you. 
 
I've already collected #1 of them from other adventurers. I don't want to let those things out of my sight.
q.9210: Bonjour ! Je suis Rudy Stribu, je redistribue les cadeaux que Iop a laissés pour vous en quittant le monde des Douze. Choisissez le cadeau qui vous conviens le mieux, je vous l'offrirai en échange d'un jeton de iop !
q.7865: Oh okay. I'll prepare the potion right this minute then.
q.9638: I see you don't have any cards; you'll need powerful sets if you expect to face me. Start by looking for cards.
q.9639: You're a formidable opponent, so give me time to perfect how I play, and I'll take revenge...
q.9645:
*Fortune smiles on you as you draw ""Eratz the Protester"", ""Edasse the Killjoy"" and ""Nomekop Wodly"". 

As indicated on the ""Cania Calling"" card, you can immediately put them into play.*""
q.9933: Let me guess... You're judging me by appearance and you think I'm some kind of wild simpleton, with an empty brain and empty pockets. But who do you think financed the construction of Bhen Neddal's palace? Ah, that's wiped the smile off your face, hasn't it? Enough chatter. If you want to venture into the cemetery of my ancestors, you will have to die first. I know that isn't a very tempting prospect. All the same, I may be inclined to help you if you bring me 5 Kaliptus Flowers and 5 Kaliptus Leaves.
q.9900:
You must use your knowledge of wildlife. Each fragment resonates with its Dofus, and therefore its former owner. For example, the Emerald Dofus from Dark Vlad, monsters in his Evil Forest and the cemetery, and bandits are naturally drawn to the fragment.



Anyway, you just need to watch the fragment and see if it reacts after a fight.
q.9902: Well... Don't lose sight of your objective. See you later.
q.9911: Well... Don't lose sight of your objective. See you later.
q.9929: Hello, young adventurer. You're not yet ready to achieve what fate has in store for you... Come back when you're more experienced.
q.9934: I'm preparing a brew, which, when ingested, will free its drinker from the hold of the Sadida sisters in the Skeunk's service. That way, I hope to be able to re-establish the calm which used to reign in these mountains. Unfortunately, I can't harvest them myself, as the Koalaks have been ordered to stop me. So far, anyone who's tried to help me has been exiled to the Primitive Cemetery.
q.9607: Nice fight! The question now is: will you continue to fight, or stop now? Note that you've collected 340 tokens so far.
q.9935: Thanks. You don't have to tell me where you got them. I'd rather not know. So, if I add them to my brew, stir it this way for 10 seconds... and 6 seconds the other way, then pour it all into a bottle... It's ready. If a Koalak drinks this, he should be free from Skeunk's hold, and that of his cursed Sadidettes. But first of all, I need to find a guinea pig to try it out on... If you agree to taste this brew, I'll help you access the Primitive Cemetery. What do you say?
q.9936: Of course, what was I thinking? You came to taste it, didn't you?
q.9937: Of course, I realise this brew isn't quite ready yet. That's why I need to make a new one. If you bring me 5 Kaliptus Flowers and 5 Kaliptus Leaves, I'll take you to the cemetery right away. Don't look so worried, I know how to get you there without putting your physical body in danger. It's true, I swear. There's no point looking so down in the mouth.
q.9943: Thank you for your help. Here's a list of the monsters I need at this time.
q.2928: May the holy whirlwind come to you, give you the divine dexterity and send you flying with swiftness!
q.338: You're not a Farmer, so you can't help me. Come back when you're a Farmer.
q.9944: It seems to me that I already gave you one of my tokens today. I just can't give away more than one a day and I can't give you another one until you've used the one you already have.
q.9950:
This is headgear that'll keep you warm, even in winter.

Do you want it?
q.1:
I'm one of #1's #5 perceptors.
I can collect up to #2 pods of items.
My prospecting is #3, which allows me to collect loot from fights, but only after the fighters have been given their share.
My wisdom is #4, and helps my guild level up.
q.85:
Joining the Order is very difficult.
Hogmeiser used to be the master of the Order of the Kicked Ass, but he disappeared several years ago, leaving only his old, worn boots behind.
q.87:
Hi! My name is Charlotte but for some reason everybody calls me Charlot. Help me to understand why by bringing me written proof and, I'll give you a nice reward.
By the way, I'm looking for Wheat Flour to make some brioches, too. I'll give you a Flax String for one unit of Wheat Flour.
q.91:
Hello, my name is Elya Wood, and I need to eat Mushrooms in order to make my wings more colourful.  
If you bring me one, I'll give you my Wand Slasher which will allow you to carve wands, provided you have learnt the appropriate trade, of course.
q.103: Hey, buddy! I'm retiring soon and so I'm selling my Shovel Smith manual. If you're interested, I'll throw in a hammer for forging shovels. I can't even lift it anymore because of my degenerative osteoarthritis...*sigh*
q.121: Hi, I'm Hugo Bello, young Feca Master. I love tickling my Gobballs to make them squeal.
q.127:
In general, bows are made with twisted Flax Strings. I spend a lot of time making my bowstrings, they're particularly robust, but flexible at the same time. 
If you're looking for Flax String for your bows, I can exchange some for a unit of Flax.
q.1108: Why are you staring at me like that? Do you think that you can pick on me just cos I'm smaller than you?
q.130: Sometimes the Tavern organises feasts. Minstrels come and play to liven things up and the price of grilled Tofu generally drops by half. Meetings can also be organised here for the members of a guild or groups of friends.
q.138:
(Grizmine puts the die in the Bronze tankard, moves the tankards around very quickly, and the die seems to pass from one tankard to another but there's no logical explanation for it)

So which tankard is the die in, my friend ?
q.145:
(Grizmine puts the die in the Bronze tankard, moves the tankards around very quickly, and the die seems to pass from one tankard to another but there's no logical explanation for it)

So which tankard is the die in, my friend ?
q.168:
Ever since the brewery was been destroyed by a thirsty Crackler, the Brewers have been out of work. The manager of the Tavern decided to lend them the cellar so that they can set up a new brewery and keep on producing their marvellous beer. 
I hope they get to work soon... our beer supplies are decreasing by the minute!
q.175: Ssssshhhhhhh...our clansshhhh forcesssshhh usssshhh...Ssshhhh...to sssssssspeak like thhhisssssshhh..SSSSssssseeemssss it makessshhhh usssss look...Ssshhhh...even more evilssssshhhhh...
q.197: Enter the labyrinth? You must be joking, I can hear your knees knocking together from here! Ha ha! Come back again when you have more experience.
q.204: Hmm, sorry, but Wiss Catz told me that he never bets unless he's totally sure he'll win. He's not going to take you up on your offer... Here's your clover.
q.7915:
Talk about a crushing victory! Magnificent! 
 
You've definitely earned this medal and these 1,250 tokens! Come back any time you want to take another shot at the Gladiatrool challenge!
q.239: Hee-Hee! I knew it! You're lost, aren't you? The exit? I don't know. I've been looking for it for years... Enough already! Stop smiling like that! I know where I am. I'm... hem... Oohh I don't know.
q.1401: Thhaaat'ss peeerfeect tiimiing! Iiit sseeemms yoouu caan iideentiify thhe Bonntaariian whhooo attaaacked Braakmmar?
q.246: I'm sorry, but I'm not going to let you in until you're experienced enough to pull out a Karne Rider's nails. If I let you in now, you'll be torn to pieces.
q.265:
If you want to challenge a Dopple, you must make a donation to the Cra temple.
It will cost you a Flax String.
q.5503: Hello, my name is Suebur Dirgah and I guard the keys. Nobody – not pauper, not soldier, not even king – can climb these steps until they show me the key.
q.285:
What ho, chap! I say! My name is Cholmondeley Featherstonehaugh. I come from the Land of Eng, and I'd like nothing more than to bally well open a spiffing top-hole restaurant, what what? I say! My speciality is wild Gobball leg with mint sauce, served with a pint of warm, flat ale. I say! What what? Yoinks!
Hmm... I say! That sounds delicious, doesn't it? Rather!
I say. But, I need mint jelly, and I'm bally well stuck here watching over the flat ale. What rotten luck, no? I'd say!
q.288: Oh... a visitor! Am I dreaming? Woohoo! Hi there! Let me introduce myself. My name is Ale One. I've been living here for more than 10 years and you're the first visitor I've seen in a very long time. I bought that land for a song at the time and now I understand why the salesman burst out laughing when I handed the money over. I've been trying to sell it myself for... let's see... 9 years, 10 months and 17 days.
q.289: I'm selling this land for next to nothing! If you buy the land, I'll throw in the house for free. You'll see, it's a really ni... really nic... really n...well, it's actually an awful place to live. I'm sick of it, but I don't have got enough money to buy myself a new place.
q.5505:
Seven allies from the same faction.
An eight to get to the bottom.
Angelic or demonic wings
A tough battle with the elements.
The most precious of materials.
q.290:
We don't have anything here. No neighbours, no running water, no entertainment, not even a local bloody supermarket!
I had nothing to eat for 9 years, 11 months and 26 days. Believe me, sucking stones all day long is rather dull... I've been dreaming of Rib Chops for nine years... oh forget it! If you bring me some Rib Chops, I'll give you sesame seeds.
q.295: Hi, my name is Jackall Breath. I'm Kwaker Vans' apprentice, and Edrige Valling's fiancé. The problem is she's been sick of my breath ever since I started eating this Curryless Curry Bread. Whenever I want to talk to her, I have to eat Mint Jelly, but it's getting more and more difficult to find. Will you help me?
q.364: Hi, I'm Ness Laye. I'm a confectioner of contentment, a harbinger of happiness... You guessed it, I'm the only one who can make happiness flakes.
q.296: I can only offer you White Flour. Edrige uses it as a foundation, but you can also make very nice bread rolls with it. A unit of White Flour for some Mint Jelly, that's a fair deal, isn't it?
q.314: It's my last stroke of inspiration...a potion even more powerful than Ghetto Raid! I know that one day, my genius will be recognised!
q.318: Hello, we are the bankers. You can open an account here and you'll have a safe place in which to keep your property. Please note that each time you access your bank account, it will cost you #1 Kamas.
q.326:
No one has yet penetrated the hole. My mission will continue until someone does. But... who are you ?! You're not Hanniboul... Leave me alone, I'm on a very special assignment.
Oh, by the way, you wouldn't be looking for scrolls, would you? I've some here if you're interested.
q.369: I'll give you a magic scroll for some ingredients.
q.329: I see... you're really stubborn. Oh, and if... no... but after all... I can't... But hey, I might as well. Okay, listen up. Bring me something to protect me against the vile creature that haunts this damp cave and I'll let you into the hole. Okay, now remember all this... l need Boowolf Testicles, Mush Mush Sporm and a pair of Captain Chafer's Leather Panties. I somehow doubt he'll want to eat me if I sling all that round my neck.
q.346: I've different tasks to offer you: Moskito extermination, collecting Treechnid Wood, the creation of a Treechnid Root Staff and the extermination of the Ancestral Treechnid.
q.349:
I hate Moskitos, these unbearable little monsters always attack me for no reason when I'm out cutting trees. 
If you bring me 10 Moskito Wings, I'll give you a Lumberjack Axe.
If you bring me 100 of them all at once, I'll give you my Lumberjack Amulet.

Moskitos are easy to find, above all near the Guilty Trees all around the lake.
q.348:
I need an amulet carved from wood to build up my collection. If my memory serves me right, Agrid the Lumberjack is wearing one around his neck, maybe he would agree to exchange it for some help. 
Bring me back this amulet and I'll exchange it for a useful parchment. 

If you like adventure, I advise you to meet the Dreggon breeder near the deserted village. He's offering a generous reward.
q.1259: Bah, you don't even have enough Kamas.
q.350:
In order to absorb all the vibrations in a more efficient way, the shaft of my axe needs to be restored with Treechnid Wood. You'll find some if you kill some of the Treechnids that doze near the Guilty Trees. Some of them hide between Farle and Shika Ingalsse's farm and the Lake of Amakna.

Bring me 10 Treechnid Roots and 10 Treechnid Barks and I'll give you a good axe in exchange.
q.359:
Boil 75 Acorns, 75 Evil Dandelion Tongues and 70 Rose Petals in a big pot for a few hours. You'll get a delicious acorn soup...
Ahh yes, so good.
q.361: To make a bunch of lollipops, I need 60 units of Blue Jelly, 30 units of Strawberry Jelly, 25 units of Mint Jelly, 1 unit of Blue Royal Jelly and 1 unit of Royal Strawberry Jelly . If you find everything for me, I'll give you a really cool surprise.
q.363:
I'm getting ready for my fifth marriage. Some people never meet the one for them, but I've met five, hey, I'm lucky. My latest fiancé is very thoughtful, and rich. 
Anyway, I've a small problem. I'm making soup, to give him strength for our wedding night. Prespic Peak soup, to be exact and for this I need... well, Prespic Peaks. Bring me 80 of them and I'll give you a Small Strength Scroll in return.
q.2247: You want to have a bet? *flips a coin* Come on, try your luck!
q.376: Hi, my name is Téha Chicks. I'm one of the worshippers of the Great Guru. I was once a lost sheep, He showed me the way. Since then, I believe in him, especially just after eating a mushroom doughnut... Skippy gave me the recipe.
q.378:
Yeah maaan! Far out, maaaaan! Peace, maaaan! Slide along the wheat! It's the Bob Man! Since our Guru, Skippy, gave me the recipe for these Mushroom and Sunflower Seed doughnuts, I'm totally in agreement with the gods. It's great, man! But I need a few thing to make some more.
Bring me 80 Mushrooms and 60 Sunflower seeds and I'll reward you with a Wisdom Scroll.
q.383:
I need so many things that I made a list! So let's see...
60 Arachnee Legs, 55 Five-Leaf Clovers, 40 Karne Rider nails and 15 Boowolf tails. 
I don't want to kill myself looking for all those things so I'll take everything in one go for a magic scroll.
q.387:
My motto is: Only give others what they already possess.
If you want me to make a scroll, bring me the ingredients, and the recipe of course...
q.1253: You'll find Captain Koda and his men in the militia's main dormitory. They're enjoying a well-deserved rest.
q.400: Hi, let's make it simple, okay, just call me The Stallion. Yesterday, I ate some Dragon Pig Ham. It's well known and widely loved but in fact, it was a really bad idea. The results were not exactly what I hoped for... So, I need some ingredients to heal me.
q.401: I need 45 Blue Larva skins, 45 Orange Larva skins, 45 Green Larva skins and 30 Evil Tofu wings.
q.406:
Without his pick, a miner is nothing. But remember, the pick doesn't make the miner. 
In general, the best picks enable you to defend yourself against the monsters which populate the mines or against prowlers who attack the miners.
If you're looking for a pick, we can come to an arrangement. I'll have a little work for you to do and I'll give you a pick if you do a good job.
q.407:
I need Elm wood to reinforce my mine and prevent it from collapsing. 
But I'm a poor Lumberjack. The last time I tried to cut down a tree, I walked on an old Treechnid root... It pursued me and laid siege to my mine for about ten days.
If you bring me 10 units of Elm woods, I'll give you a miner's pick.
Don't hesitate to call on a Lumberjack if you don't want to lose too much time.
q.1562: Whatever you do, please don't tell my parents I'm here.
q.1564: Listen to me, adventurer, don't tell my wife I'm here!
q.417:
Though Amakna itself is quite peaceful, the same cannot be said of the surrounding country.
If you stay close to the town, you should be okay - they usually won't strike the first blow.
The farther you move away from the centre of Amakna the more aggressive these creatures are. They may attack you for no reason.
Stay in the village if you're not accompanied by other adventurers, or you might have an unpleasant encounter.
q.418:
Some warriors originally from Amakna decided to join the ranks of most powerful cities such as Bonta or Brakmar.
In order to spread their ideology, they sometimes attack the inhabitants of the region of Amakna in the hope they'll convince them to join their ranks. As long as you'll stay in neutral land, the garrison of Amakna will help you. However, once out of this zone, it will be at your own risks...
q.422:
Swords are the favourite weapons of Ecaflips and Iops. To handle such swords you must be very strong, but they often cause great damage.
Sword Smiths use the Sword Smith Hammer.
q.423:
Srams are the daggers specialists. Daggers are quite fast but generally don't cause much damage. On the other hand, their critical hits are really impressive. 
Agility is essential to properly handle Daggers. Indeed, as a close combat weapon, you need to be able to approach, hit and run away from your enemy.
Dagger Smiths use the Dagger Smith Hammer.
q.425:
Hammers are the favourite weapons of Osamodas and Xelors. In general, they require a little strength and a great deal of intelligence to be handled. Indeed, most hammers have powerful magical properties.
Hammer Smiths use the Hammer Smith Hammer.
q.428:
Staffs are not effective in close combat but they give great power to their holder. 
The Sadida and Feca classes are pretty good with Staffs. In general, they require a little strength and much intelligence to be handled.
Staff Carvers use a Staff Gasher.
q.429:
Greetings, disciple, I'm one of the six Rogue Masters. Vil Smisse is our Grand Master.
If you want to progress through the Order and obtain more authority, you'll have to carry out numerous quests and tasks in order to prove your merit.
q.430:
I've several missions for you. But for some of them I need warriors of trust who have proven their devotion to the Rogues.
You may specialise in several fields, such as robbery or assassination, but we also need couriers to deliver messages to the different evil masters of the region.
q.9609: Nice fight! The question now is: will you continue to fight, or stop now? Note that you've collected 700 tokens so far.
q.436:
He's been waiting for years near the bridge to warn the potential adventurers about the danger that awaits them.
You know, he's responsible for the disaster which forced us to flee here and rebuild our village. 
If you manage to help him, he will certainly give you his Old Dreggon Bone - it's got magic powers.
If you know how to use it correctly it will bestow great powers on amulets.
q.438:
Ah, you know Hanniboul Smisse? He's our chief, he's in charge around here and he'll do whatever it takes to rescue me when crazy people take me for a crazy person and try to lock me up.
I shouldn't be telling you this, though.
q.9606: Nice fight! The question now is: will you continue to fight, or stop now? Note that you've collected 220 tokens so far.
q.442:
This Treechnid is one of the oldest in the Province of Amakna. It has already killed most of my Lumberjack friends but worse than that, it killed my family one night while we were sleeping out in the open.
It happened deep in the forest I'm the only one who survived...
I want to take my revenge but I can't do it myself... That's why I'm asking you to do it for me... Go and kill that monster and I'll reward you fairly.
q.443:
To take revenge on that monstrous creature, I'll never forget it...
Once you've killed it, take an Ancestral Amber and try to forge Ancestral Daggers out of it.

Then bring me back these daggers and I'll give you Ancestral wood in exchange. Ancestral wood is used in the manufacture of a famous Amulet with dazzling powers or even in the restoration of the legendary Splitter of Ancestral Treechnid, an axe that will make its holder one of the most powerful warriors in Amakna.
But be careful, You'll have to find a very experienced Dagger Smith to forge the daggers that I'm looking for. And to manufacture this amulet I'm talking about or to forge this famous axe, you'll have to ask outstanding craftsmen.
One last thing, don't underestimate the power of that Ancestral Treechnid...
q.444:
It's older than the oldest Enutrof, more deceitful than the most deceitful Rogue and more dangerous than a drunken Bwork Magus.
You shouldn't challenge it alone, it often goes out for a walk, with its whole army of Arachnees in the forests near the Southern Sawmill. It's always in search of new lumberjacks to devour.
One last thing, beware of its magic. It almost killed Brouce Boulgour the Lumberjack last winter.
q.449: If the hammer doesn't interest you, you can give me Gobball Horns, and I'll give you a Small Wisdom Scroll in return. You'll need 100 horns per scroll.
q.456:

My brothers must have started training you already.
So you're looking forward to exploring Amakna...
Choose your profession soon. Go explore new territories, and try to master as many spells and types of equipment as you can...
Always be careful in this world and mistrust the dark side of other adventurers.

q.940:
Hi!
Did you know that Bonta has an outer wall built of no less than 128.369 Crackler stones?
Did you know that it took 250 labourers to build that wall and that about 1 in every 32 of them died in great pain during its construction?
No, you didn't! I knew you didn't know it!

But you can believe that they're using part of the city's budget, #1 Kamas to be exact, to pay their widows' pensions?

Of course you can't believe it. But I said it, so it must be so. Now, go away, I'm busy.
q.644:
The world of Dofus is rather unusual...
it's an eventful universe and lately some nasty creatures have been invading the plains, fields and mountains.
For the moment, the villages are the only safe places.
The further away from a village you go, the more dangerous it will get. But that's the price you pay for glory. 

In Amakna, the entire economy is controlled by the warriors and craftsmen, and trade between them is vital.
If you misbehave, you might be named a rogue (demon wings) and get chased off by the dispensers of justice (angel wings). 
Make the right choices and be careful... if you mess up you could go to jail.
q.645:
There are numerous gods in our universe. You chose your beliefs a long time ago and you master a couple of techniques, but you still have a way to go.

You can lead your life and career as you want, every trade has its value.

Some prefer to fight, others have a profession and others again do the two at the same time. There is no wrong way of evolving, only choices to make. 

You can get more information on your characteristics by clicking on the round pictogram of the DNA strand on the bottom interface, on the top right of your portrait. At each level up, you gain 5 characteristic points to share out among wisdom, vitality, strength, intelligence, agility and chance.

q.663: I can give you some Great Scrolls of Wisdom if you can bring me back 90 Mushrooms, 75 Sunflower Seeds, 60 Hemp Seeds and 200 Moskito Wings.

The same way I wouldn't stand up for anyone. However, I can sell you a book that recounts the legend of the forest.
q.670: Metarias are raw materials. Wrought by alchemists, they can be used to make powerful elemental potions which will enable you to impregnate items with various elements. My last works show the effectiveness of this method on weapons, as well as the difficulties involved in mixing reality with magic. That's why I developed a method to help me do it... but I only teach it to some people.

q.760:

One of them is particularly tough: the mummy nova.
Take it as a test, but if you bring me some pieces of its wrapping, I'll name you officer of the militia of Bonta.
