q.2088: Ma Cleopatra has developed a cure... What a gifted healer, she gives a great foot massage too... but anyway! Find her and ask her if she can give you some Subosycold. Then, bring it to Clint Pot. He's an Enutrof, he will know how to care for our Tofus. Just follow your compass.
q.2089:
It's the very first time the Enutrofs have ever needed this remedy... Something must be going wrong underground. Would you mind investigating for me? Come back with a detailed report of anything out of the ordinary. Take this hammer, too. Hammers are good, know what I mean?!
Just follow your compass.
q.2090: Hello there, young Feca. My name is Fallanster. My daughter, Allisteria, told me about all the things you've done. She didn't have time to bring you a bowl of our Gobball black pudding stew, it was all gone in a flash!
q.2099: Well... That's not a very good start! *she starts screaming* Daddy, Daddy!
q.2105: The Seer Blow, of course! I'll become rich and famous with this spell! If you want to learn more about it, have a seat, take a beer and listen to me, my friend. This is a fantastic story!
q.2108: Saketsu told me you'd come. Thanks a lot! Let's see what this drop of blood can tell us. Well, of course it's just a figure of speech! After a few tests, I'll know which illness struck him!
q.2115: Sorry but I don't have time to talk with you. I've got a lot of creatures to kill... Do you want me to show you what I'm up to?
q.2121: A conspiracy! The town is finished... everyone might die... Hey you... Flee! Get outta here!
q.2122:
Shovel... useless... ground... too hard... no digging... I need planks! Two chestnut tree planks...! 
Food! Survive? Yes... need bread... three loaves... Amakna Bread!
q.2262: But what have you done? I'm not interested in knowing you if you can't get what has to be done into your big loaf.. Take another leaf and look harder this time...
q.2143: Everything, everything EVERY BLOODY THING!! The Fecas have to take care of everything! You'd think we were the only ones with a brain...and please don't mention these lops... please! I feel stupid just bloody well thinking about the cretins.
q.2130: You're looking for some Subosycold? Sure! It would still be more courteous of the Enutrofs to come and pick it up themselves. Oh well, I still haven't found a remedy to this obsessive scourge that makes them dig everywhere they shouldn't...
q.2135: Thanks a lot. Please, just wait a minute... There you go, that's PER-FECT, you look delightful in it. Mummy always said I was talented.
q.2136: Ahh, not you again? Go and tell Mon'Hawt'Wit' at the Eniripsas' place before Joe loses his patience! Time is Kamas, and Joe loves Kamas, so you'd better hurry the hell up!
q.2138: Okay, getting better! So you warned everyone... Hey! Don't you even think about sitting down, you maggot? Go back and report to Joe Stonefiddler.
q.9630:
A note reads: 
 
"Greetings! 
I'm sorry, but the Gladiatrool is temporarily closed. I had to run out and stock up on creatures. Try again later!" 
 
It's signed, "Notend Less"
q.2146: Well, she bet that the Enutrofs weren't brave enough to venture into the underpasses, with all that's been going on, you know, all the killings and stuff. On the contrary, I told her, they go there all the more, now there's a good chance of dying.
q.2148: I see you have no weapon. Here, please take this purse, it's full of Kamas that Kwartzwatch kindly gave me. There should be more than enough for you to buy one. I think Kwartzwatch might have played a trick on me, though - the coins might disappear soon if no one takes them!
q.2177: Dear #1... You know that we, the Srams, can invoke a double of ourselves. And right now, you're talking to my double. Ahha! I'll be glad to explain it all if we ever meet each other around Brakmar. But for now, I've a mission to entrust you with!
q.2180: Argh, that's what I was afraid of... even my skills have their limits. But Ma Cleopatra's talent is as unwavering as Djaul's stench-ridden breath. I told her about it, and I think she'll be able to help Locette, go and talk to her, quickly!
q.2181: Oh, you're here for Locette, I've been thinking of her. I thought of an ancestral remedy that could work in her case: a potion so hot and so stinky that her senses will be revived. Fight fire with fire, that's my motto. I need a large quantity of Gobball's saliva, a bit of evil rose saliva, and some Mush Mush Thorns. Bring me all these elements, please!
q.2184: A runaway care stone? Give me that, quickly...*Shani rushes to his workroom and comes back two minutes later. The stone has been set into a metal bezel.* Once it's been extracted from the rock, the stone loses its power very quickly. Only this metal can retain the stone's power.
q.2189: Hummm... let me think... you've got your wood out, so I reckon you want a bow job, right? Alright... but you'll have to hand over quite a few Kamas!
q.2680: Ahahahaha! That's no news to a Pandawa!
q.2194: Here is a masterpiece... You just have to find someone who knows how to install the cord. Dear Setsinbol will be alright but everyone knows that his son Ticra is the best.
q.2244: Sorry... I'm too busy to talk at the moment... I'm training my Tofus to help the Enutrofs in their underground work.
q.2196: What the...?! I've just watched you die... You must have some time left, then. My vision is muddy of late... it must be all that wood? I told you to bring virgin stuff! Ah, that bloody Oli Venders! Well, I suppose I'll need a blue larva skin to clarify my vision. Here! Take this hammer and go get one!
q.2197:
I still need a blue larva skin. 
Go have a look round the Northern gate of Astrub, that's where all the best larvae hang out.
q.2198: Perfect. Here we are, ahahah! Ahem! Excuse me! Very well, let's have a look... *Kwartzwatch focuses on the flow of Epyss, then is overcome by bolts of lightning, and she drops the hourglass, which breaks* By the Twelve! What was that vision? Let me come back to my senses. May Xelor have mercy, I fear the worst...
q.2560: I can see by youl bloodshot eye that you callied out youl mission! You deselve to know the stoly of oul people.
q.2203: Well... you know, I'm not ze person for the administration... neither the Tofus, by ze way... but some person must have to do it! SO! Why don't YOU do zis? Of course not! Joking! 'Ave a nice day anyway!
q.2204: Hem... I don't want to be rude, but apart from MacGiven, I don't know anybody who could make a bow with this stuff...
q.2208: Hm! Sick and tired of me, are you? Here you go, I've some 'urrywood left but be careful, iss verry verry rare sing!
q.2209: Have a look mate! A pure link to nature, as master SadadI'd say. And I think that will come in handy: nature sensed something evil in the tunnels, and Enutrofs are in danger! If you have some time before your nap, can you go there and see what's going on? I must help the master, he's having a hard time.
q.2401: Are you sure you want to spend days on end in the darkness, chipping away at a wall of rock? Being a miner is a vocation, you know that, don't you?
q.2214:
Oh! So, you're the back-up? Well, we'll have to make do... Okay, here's the situation: the Osamodas have lent us some Tofus to help us find gas leaks. They warn us in case of danger, ya see? We call them sniffallrats. 
I think they smelt somethin' - but it ain't gas... Some of them came back in a pretty bad shape, and I don't think that Subosycold will do it any good. Ours left to find the Sniffallrats some time ago... I'm afraid they have been captured by those bloody rats. Please, try to find them!
q.2227: Hum... I think I'll be able to help you. I'm going to use a potion to stiffen the string. Then, you'll see how precise your bow will be. Stay here, I'll do that right now.
q.2235: Thank for beautiful cake. It's for Oz. With that, he can do what I want him... Deliver on the time! Good!
q.2242:
*Gazing at a small flax flower*
Look at this beauty! This is a gift from Nature - a true marvel so delicately given to us. Let's take care of it and preserve it.
q.2624: Argh! How did you know I was not a real Pandawa?!
q.2255: You're the backup?! Well, we'll have to make do with that...Here's the thing: the Osamodas have lent us Tofus who sniff around to smell if there's any gas leaks and they warn us when it becomes too dangerous, see? We call them 'sniffallrats'.
q.2259: Oh, thanks a lot, I knew I could count on you... Here, take this loaf of bread, it'll heal your wounds...
q.2261:
Creating a group will allow you to communicate easily and rapidly with the adventurers you'll have gathered during a game.
But you have to distinguish a group from a guild. A group is temporary. The guild is permanent and is subject to conditions.
q.2263:
Hey! Hello... hi! How are you? Good... good. That's great. I was just thinking, you know, like, whyyyy... do people have so many different types of hair?
I've counted, like, eleven types of hair in the world. I was actually needing to get all the hair together to have a... oh my god... could you, like, maybe... if I give you a list could you, like, bring me back one strand of each type?
q.2408: Oh I see, Kana Petch's bait. Take it and hurry, there are limits to his patience.
q.2269:
Ohhh, thank you... thank you so much! Take my damaged scissors, you might need them!

While you were gone, I, like, tried to sell a Sadidette wig to a lop, but, like, he was not buying! No way!
I'm telling you, it would be sooo cool if you could get that list of hair for me, seriously, that would be like so sweet of you!
q.2285: The inhabitants of our land are very fascinating creatures. There's nothing like setting off to discover the local wildlife and improving your zoological and botanical knowledge. A light heart and good will, it's all you need to give them the willies most of the time.
q.2286: You need to know one thing however - if you accidentally offend one of them, they'll certainly look for their revenge... Nothing too bad... like they might eat a limb off or something. Haha! Or crush your bones! So, listen to me, carefully...
q.2279:
*mumbles*
May the god Iop give you vitality, may your sword squeal and be sharp, may your arm be long with Compulsion!
q.2512: Here, give him this magnificent counterfeit Dofus on behalf of the Enutrofs of Astrub.
q.2288: I'd like to tell you... But afterwards, I'd have to tie your nice little pink tongue in a knot so you wouldn't be able to tell anyone else...*a slightly unfriendly grin*
q.2290: A hairy creature of the size of a Miliboowolf that attacks the Gobballs at night? Hm, it sounds like the work of the Bearman... Perhaps you've heard of this fellow... who can control bears. They say that all his power comes from an old Osamodas manuscript. If you steal it from him, you'll stop this terrible Gobball slaughter, but remember, you cannot succeed alone. Unless you challenge him with a group of adventurers, he will not use his scroll... first things first though... you'll need to find his lair first. It shouldn't be difficult - this kind of creature always leaves trace behind...
q.2295: Poisoned acorns...No, they're certainly too cunning to fall into that trap... Maybe another doll... bloody squirrels *grmbl*
q.2305: Keuf! Kof! Keuf! *belches in a weird way*
q.2314: Argh! You gave me a fright, ye fool! Thought you were one of those big grossewer rats... Speaking of rats, I think I got somethin' to suit a strappin' young thing like yourself... right up your street... Let's have a look here... A fine fellow!!
q.2319: There are loads of sick Tofus in these underground galleries. Eniripsas asked us to get a few feathers for medical tests, but it's a pain in the neck to catch the animals... I'd need a good deal of feathers : besides the fact that Eniripsas want to get some, it's a really good business! 10 feathers of these sick Tofus should be enough.
q.2323: Our Cra friends have weird ideas sometimes. They take advantage of infectious aged-aunts that are present in those Arachnee legs to make poisoned arrows! Weird, but efficient... If you wanna make a little money, bring me 20 of those Arachnee legs. Somethin' tell me I'm goin' to have to throw my sandwiches away... *sigh*
q.2325: You must have met these rats... You might even have fought some of 'em. I heard that when you kill 'em, they come back by hundreds... Unbliv'able! But once again, the old Ant sure found a way to get some' from it! Hahaha!... Ahem.... They have very shiny teeth, and Xelors seem particularly interested in these... probably to put hands on their hourglass! Hahaha! Ok, I see what you want, right? I knew it! 10 of these objects should be sufficient.
q.2337:
A dark rose... hmmm, that is crazy! So, the flowers are still mutating then, and turning into more and more powerful species!
Your information gave me an idea for an experiment... I want you to take care of it for me.
Take these dark rose seeds and plant them in the Astrub fields, under the rock over there! Hihihihiii! We'll see some sparks fly.
q.2349:
There is a limit on the number of objects you can sell at once.
You have to wait until some are sold before putting others on sale.
After a while, if some items haven't been sold, they're taken out of the marketplace and put back directly in your safe at the bank.
q.2352: Tell me, you really want to become an alchemist ? Yes, I'm a trainer. Well, so listen to me: a good alchemist must learn to understand the intensity, the magic essence, of every object and be able to manipulate it at will. Take a new look at every object that you possess now or that you have possessed in the past.
q.2353: Well, all 'know is that the council asked us to patrol in those damn underpasses... 'Must know more about this stuff than me, that's for sure! And the old legends are not going to calm things down, betcha!
q.2366: There's some pretty big monsters over there... Even my granddaddy never heard of them, they'd scare a lop they would! And then there's all those old legends.
q.2367: Well, you know, Dofus and all that stuff... You know, dragon eggs that give powers, you can't find a lot of that around, and with all those adventurers arriving, it's the egg rush! Well, I gotta go, have a good trip! And may the stones be soft under your feet!
q.2376: I can only teach you one specialty - either wand, staff or bow sculpting. But if you're very dedicated and have a lot of time, you might manage to do two of them.
q.2383: Are you sure you want to start a career as a Dagger smith?
q.2384: Are you sure you want to start a career as a Shovel smith?
q.2389: Here come the reinforcements! So, it seems you came out of it unscathed... along with the Pyrite Brothers... but the poor fellows are in a sorry state! Bah!... Some Pandala fresh air will put them on their feet again! You should go see Surivitna. He's the Shaman of Pandala... You look quite peaky yourself...
q.2538: Because Grandapan has one foot on Pandala and the other one in the kingdom of the gods!
q.2392: So, mercenary, you're looking for animals to hunt and Kamas to spend? Well it's your lucky day! Have a look at the wanted posters, and bring back whoever you can.
q.2393: Well, you're now my apprentice. You'll start with small creations, I've drawn designs for them in your notebook. You'll also need some specially designed slashers for what you're going to sculpt. I sell many different kinds if you want to get one. Try to pick up the right slasher! Once you get it, you can use our work benches for sculpting.
q.2397: You're now the apprentice under my supervision, don't disappoint me! To cut down trees, you'll need a good axe - you can buy one of mine for now, I'll give you a good price. Once you have it in your hands, pick a tree and start chopping like a nutter! One last thing, don't choose a hardwood tree. I'll write down where the softer trees are in your lumberjack's logbook, then you can practice on them.
q.2400: Mining is a vocation, it takes a lot of time but it's worth it in the end. At the beginning, of course, you only find pig iron or shiny pebbles... It's a matter of intuition. But once you have some experience, you'll find your gold, don't you worry!
q.2415: The craftspeople create useful objects from raw materials - most often bought from harvesters, but often picked up from romantic adventures whose tall tales are matched only by the contents of their pockets! As a result, it's a tougher profession than harvesting. For one thing it requires more investment. It's like they say, you have to spend some to get some.
q.2422: The miner extracts the metal used by jewellers and blacksmiths as raw material. Some of the stones they find will also have magical value. From time to time, miners uncover valuable diamonds and the like - a rare occurrence, but it does happen. The mines themselves are few and far between and violent turf wars are not uncommon!
q.2426: There are many types of carvers, one specialising in each type of weapon - staffs, wands and other wooden implements. Lots of wood and a bit of everything else are used in these trades. As with any crafting profession, you'll have to have a few Kamas saved up to get off the ground, but if you put in a few years of hard craft, you'll be putting your feet up for good before too long!
q.2427: Jewellers make all kinds of rings and necklaces, often imbuing them with magical powers. From the simplest metal ring to the most terrifyingly powerful necklace, jewellers channel the elemental forces found in special metals and other materials. This profession requires more skill and patience than most.
q.2429: Tailors are the movers and shakers in the world of fashion. Don't take them for a bunch of sissies though, their cloaks and hats can lend fearsome powers to those who wear them. It'll take a while to find your own style, but keep working at it and you'll soon have as many secrets to jealously guard as the unhelpful masters of your art.
q.2439: The baker makes his fine breads according to safely guarded traditions. Bread is perfect for a quick snack while you're roaming the world on important quests. The final product depends first and foremost, however, on flour, the raw material of any bread. Rumour has it that eating it regularly makes you stronger.
q.2442: Our lands are populated with the most fascinating creatures. You should go into the wilderness to find the local flora and fauna and to improve your zoological and botanical knowledge. Heartfelt and pure intentions are usually enough to cajole them.
q.2443: However, there's something you need to know : if you happen to offend one of them by mistake, she'll probably be angry with you... Nothing serious, really, but she may want to stuff herself with your guts! She might wish to crush your bones as well! So, listen carefully...
q.2444: Just like you, all the creatures down here are either resistant or sensitive to the four primordial elements: air, earth, fire and water. Learn to recognise their strengths and weaknesses – and yours! – and the World of Twelve will be safe for you. Or almost safe.
q.2447: Life is hard down here. If a creature finishes off your vitality, you'll be shattered. You'll have to sit down somewhere to recover from your wounds. If it's more serious, eat some bread, which you can buy from a baker, or drink a healing potion - some alchemists make excellent ones. After that, you can make the most out of life.
q.2459: In the course of your adventure, you'll experience many exciting things. All these missions will be written down in your questbook. Can you see this old book down there? It will help your compass work. You should always keep an eye on it. It's going to be more than a guide for you, it will be a true testimony of your progression.
q.2469: You're a fast learner, young #1. I think you're ready to go back to Incarnam now. Oh, wait! I almost forgot. Remember that this world is full of adventurers like you. Don't hesitate to talk to them using your communication zone (below on the left). Some will need help, others will help you, and you'll even find people with quests to offer. Start by looking near the Soul Temple, they'll be easy to spot...
q.2474: That's a fine bridge alright! We gave the Pandawas quite a hand! But we must fill in these breaches or else everything might just collapse. Yep... amber... that's what we need.
q.2479: If I only knew! He was last seen taking the road to Amakna, since then nothing...
q.2485: Thanks a lot! We can get back to work now... (he yawns).
q.2489: Ello, ello! 'Ave you seen Toyo Dzink by any chance? He's a mate of mine... looking for Amber, he was, now I'm lookin' for him... I've heard he might be on the road between Astrub and Amakna. But there's no amber there, he shoulda gone South! He'd be very grateful if you gave him some.
q.2499: This is a local specialty. There are a lot of them on Pandala island: the Pandneken, the Pandwiser, the Pandaburg... You'll get to know them soon... *Knowing wink.*
q.2519: This fake dragon egg has come at just the right moment! How about we create genuine copies... Made in Pandala? We just need to paint Dragoturkey eggs. Adventurers will never find out! They'll sell like hot Amakna cakes, believe me! Ahah, I'm a genius...I just need to stop thinking out loud...
q.2520: Mumble... Dofus... mumble... Grandapan... mumble... World conquest... mumblemumble.... gwahahaha!
q.2524: O! Pandawaaa! Hear my prayers: Goddess, a li'l drink, we're thirsty, Goddess, a li'l drink, we're thirsty...! Oh, but I'm missing the most important thing: a flask of Pandneken! We can't drink to Pandawa, huh... I mean, make her a libation without a flask of Pandneken! Go see the peddler at the harbour, he has some! Hurry up! The goddess is losing patience!
q.2536: Grandapan knows a lot of things! The Dofus receptacle is a genuine relic passed down by our ancestors... but don't tell me that's all you've seen. Doesn't it prove the truth of the legend? Go ahead and have a look. It will definitely convince you. Oh! Have you felt the wisdom that shoots through your body when you look at the ancient statue of our goddess? You must see it as soon as possible!
q.2526:
Shush
*in a low voice*
Before you talk to me, you must sort out the tax problem... cause you're not welcome around here. That's why I can't talk to you openly. Traditions, you know.
Come back when you've paid and then we'll talk.
q.2550: I can tell from your look that you came to help us! (News circulates quite fast in Pandala!) All my Pandawas are busy at the moment and I need someone I can trust to bring those Bamboos to the Shield Smith.
q.2552: If you say no, you're insulting me. If you're insulting me, you're insulting all the Pandawas, not mentioning our goddess... After that, it won't be easy to get information about the Dofus of Pandala... And isn't that the reason you're here?
q.2558: Don't deny the obvious! I know you brought one of those damned Dofus onto our island! We saw you going out of the Shaman's house! You broke the Pandikaze rule n°1: No Dofus on Pandala. I sentence you to ingest Pandweiser until you die! You'll be executed tomorrow. Imprison him, and good night!
q.9954: Ugh... I loathe this time of year... What do you want?
q.2562: Among the Dofus awe fake ones... Genuine Dofus awe laid by dwagons. Only dummies can think Cawwots lay eggs! The Cawwot Dofus is an enchanted Cawwot by Wa Wabbit which gives it enormous powers...
q.2565: I know you've come a long way. Dark Vlad went mad a long time ago... No one can come out unchanged of this encounter: your spirit's stronger now!
q.2566: Learn this: I used to be a very powerful Lenald, the most powerful of all. I was the Dofus warden! And when the Wabbits invaded our island, I took the precious egg with me.
q.2567: You understood: the Dofus NEVER left Pandala... It's on this island: a white Dofus, immaculate that no one touch for ages... I hid it inside the dungeon of the peninsula, north-east of Pandala!
q.2571: I can see at youw feet that you walked a long way to come visit me. So listen to me cawefully: among the Dofus awe fake ones... Genuine Dofus awe laid by dwagons. What's this... ridiculous, there's a warning saying: It's best to wear a Sue-Dough-Ku necklace!

*in a low voice* Why is he so popular... is it because of his hair?
I'm sorry but my son's already engaged to the daughter of the Dojo's owner. I could never let him go again for a sum below 100,000 Kamas.

HHEEIIITIITT!

q.2650: The Pandasiman, or The dodging shield is one of the Pandawushus' best schools. What's special about this art is that the shield is used actively and not just as defence.
q.2652: Wisdom makes you talk, or perhaps it's stupidity. Indeed, this art has a certain weakness which is quite a strength at the same time. The Pandasiman art has been developed to limit losses during Pandawaiian wars. All our shields and parries are developed to face particular types of opponents, in particular types of fights.
q.7892:
Heh heh... thank you! You're a smart one, I can tell.

*throws a smoke bomb on the ground and escapes*

This basic move is called the Pandasiman-Screen: it's the essence of our art. Then you have more and more complex sequences which only masters can perform.
q.2655: The shield smith is sending you? Very well. Get your training shield and tell me when you're ready.
q.2664:

q.2703: I know vely little my fliend. But I know enough to please you. Bling a flask of Pandapiler to my old fwiend, the Chief of the village of Akwadala. And I'll tell you evelything I know about the Dofus of Pandala.

q.2807: What are you doing here? This is my place, my room... my kittie basket. If you're not a friend of mine, get out of here. Unless you're me. ARE YOU ME?! NO!! Get out of here. Flee before it emerges and kills you!
q.2814: Mmh, You've got a LONG way to go... A Kwan is a short question that the Master asks his Disciple.

q.2828: Be quiet! I'm not stupid! You don't give me any choice. Tomorrow you'll disappear forever. We'll throw you into a tank of pure Pandka... You know too much. Sometimes you have to make a few sacrifices before you get what you want.

q.9635:

So do you want it?
q.2838:

You must have heard that the Brakmarians have set fire to the Militia's Dragoturkey food stores. You must be wondering why they did that, no? Well now's your chance to find out. 
I want you to go to the Tower of Brakmar immediately and find out what the Brakmarians are up to.
While you're there, pay a visit to Fidji Merline and give her this, she'll understand. Once she's read the letter, she'll tell you exactly what to do, you'd better listen carefully. I'm counting on you.
q.2839:
Greetings #1! You look as radiant as a phoenix, young disciple.
What can I do for you?
q.2865:
I sent some Brakmarians to kill some of the Bontarian militia's Dragoturkeys and to steal from their provisions, but the idiots were scared off by the group of guards around the paddock. Afraid of being caught, they retreated and burnt the food warehouse on their way, leaving the Dragoturkeys alive and returning without a scrap of food for Brakmar. Our food supply has not been replenished.

You must go to Astrub to find Raymon Santho, a trader with ties to Bonta. Do whatever you have to win him over to our side.
q.2867: Stop! You can't go any further... The Pandikazes have sabotaged the bridge leading to the peninsula...

q.2875:
You can deposit both Kamas and items in your bank account.
You can only have one bank account. 
Every time you access your bank account, even if you're just having a look inside, you must pay a fee.
This fee depends on the number of items stored in your bank account, and the number of items you can store in your bank account is determined by how long you've banked with us. Each person living in the province of Amakna gets a bank account.

So, as time passes by, it will cost you more and more to access your account, as you deposit more items in it. However, the longer you stay with us, the more items you'll be able to put in it.
q.9636:
Oh! Excellent choice! It's a very special mount that you won't find anywhere else. 
 
So do you want it?
q.2881:
Capturing a group of souls is real easy. First, you must keep an empty soul stone in your hand while fighting.
Then, you must cast a spell at the end of the fight in order to send the souls flying into the air... finally you must try to catch them.

Be careful! If the spell is cast too soon, it'll vanish and you won't be able to catch any wandering souls.

About this spell, well... I can't teach it to you. But it seems it can be found in deep caves on Pandala Island.
q.2937:
Haha, you're a true tunneller! I'll stop bugging you now. I've enough data to try to find a theory and draw up the map of what you've explored.... It might be my first bestseller!

There are still heaps of mysterious tunnels described in this book... in the Dark Smith Dungeon, in Sufokia... Come back and visit in a while... I might still need your help to explore all this!
q.3083: Thank you for being so... quiet about all this. If you've got some spare time, come back to me. I might have a delivery for you.
q.2940: Hmm, I see you have a key to this den... So, I'm going to let you in. But be careful, I don't think my colleagues will go easy on you. The Pandora Master who settled here has recruited the best Pandikazes to protect him. Are you sure you want to come in?
q.2951: What a pity... But I do understand how you feel. A long time ago, I went through the same thing. By the way, I forgot to tell you the good news. I'm in the middle of some important repairs to my church... Now, I don't like to do this, but before I can annul your marriage and declare your divorce, well, maybe you could help... How about a modest 10,000 Kamas for a new cassock, 15,000 Kamas to redo all the church windows, 5,000 Kamas to take care of my beard, and 20,000 Kamas to buy a few drops of communion wine... All together, I'd need 50,000 Kamas. Bless you!!
q.2972: Haha! Typical! You've been asked to do something and you've done it! You really thought I'd believe you? Well... A Pandawa, you say? It could be, though! Who could be that stupid to brag about a Dofawa?
q.2974: I advise you destroy this item straight away! You don't want to be caught with a Dofawa by the mercenaries of Astrub, believe me... The best thing for you to do would be to get some information about the governing laws of our regions. This way you won't put your life at stake unnecessarily. Go to the jail in Astrub, mercenaries will tell you more about Dofus and Pandala.
q.9880: ... Otomai placed his trust in you, and you showed him that you deserved the Ochre Dofus...
q.2986: I can see you're eloquent! don't hesitate to consult your star. It will tell you how you should speak to people around you. You'll be able to charm the opposite sex by telling them exactly how you feel and to make many, many friends... And when you're a bit harder, you'll be able to train an Adventurer Group and talk to them like a chief. You'll be part of a Guild and its members will listen to you!
q.2994: Of course, I knew it... Make sure that your words are being said on the right side of the star or else no one will hear you! And don't pollute the World's atmosphere with impure words. To make it short, just behave and be polite! Don't be like Herdegrize... the old erudite man insults others far too often. He truly hates me you know... I think he was a Gobball in a previous life. And obviously when he sees me reading their entrails, it makes him really mad...
q.2999: Just find a Purple Piwi... there are heaps in this area and at the entrance of the mine. Attack it gently without scaring it and you'll probably get a purple feather. If you don't get one, just try again. You'll surely get one sooner or later! You'll see what you've won at the end of the fight. The items will be listed in your inventory...
q.3000: Not always, but most of the time! Each creature is able to bring you items, like a lining or a pair of boots, or resources or leather or amber etc. All these finds have considerable market value...and if you're lucky you'll find a guildalogem! This stone will allow you to create your own guild... If you want to learn more about this subject, go to the Guild Temple...
q.3005: With these scrolls you'll quickly be able to complete your training. I exchange them against 100 and 105 Gobball horns depending on their types. There are many persons that will exchange you scrolls in our world... You just have to find them!
q.3016: Wooohhoooo! Fallen warriors from the Crimson Dawn Battle, let your spirits talk to me! What is disturbing your sleep? Just tell me! Mmm?
q.3019: Well... if you'd rather die as an idiot and haunt a crappy grave for ever... Your call...
q.3025: Menalt's spirit can't rest in peace. His wrath disturbs the sleep of the dead... Since he's been buried here after the Crimson Dawn Battle, his anger is gnawing at him: his head was stolen and he wants it back! At all costs! Besides, if we, centaurs, became Perceptors, it's above all to find Menalt's missing head... I'd prefer to find it before he does... Trust me, if he succeeds in raising an army of the living dead, we'll know all about it!
q.3163: I'm sure you'd like to know what lies on top of the mountain behind these steps. Well it's simple, I trapped the biggest Crackler I ever managed to catch there and he can't get back down now as he's put on quite a bit of weight. He's huge, monstrous, terrifying even! He's so dangerous that I've blocked access to the steps. If you have a key on you, I'll let you go past, and you'll see that I wasn't lying, and you'll probably be scared, so you'll cry like a little girl, begging me, Krunchie the Crackler hunter, to help you!
q.3032: Brakmar and its tadpole army fled once again when facing the courageous warriors of Bonta. Enlist in Bonta and you'll always be a winner!
q.3035: Yooohhoooo! Yoooohooooo! Is there a spirit available to keep me company? Yooooohhhooooo! Anybody there? Yooooohhooooo! Yooohhoooo!
q.3058: Here are the planks. I'll use them for the framework. Now, I'll need rocks for the walls.
q.3074: A shark is spreading panic in the harbour. Find it and come tell me where it wreaks its sharkish terror.
q.3079: Another day full of action. Watch your teeth by the way!
q.3082: She wants more? These Enutrofs really earn their bad reputation. Here's another 1,000 Kamas. Hurry back for your reward.
q.3090: I'm interested in this potion. It will come in handy for my business. Here are the Kamas. I feel like a boom is coming... soon my boots will be polished with Royal Slobber.
q.3100: I've no idea what this shark's looking for. A beer-marinated docker?
q.3110: Thanks for the potatoes. I don't like it at all when I run out! I'd love to have a Twiggy Shovel, then I could grow them myself.

Ha! I'm kidding! We work together with breeders to invent various machines to take care of the mounts, so their owners are free to wander round the town or just sit still for days on end on their porches - a popular pastime round these parts. But mounts are quite violent when handled by heavy machinery, so our inventions always end up getting worn out before long. It's great for business!!
q.3164: Bring me back the ingredients I need to finish my potion.

q.3167:
Last time I saw Lord Crow, he was in Library room number 1...

Lord Crow is in 9720!

You really deserve this key I've just given you. But remember, Skeunk is an Eniripsa Master and he's very dangerous. For what I know, no one has ever defeated him!
To find Skeunk, you'll have to cross an arid valley filled with dangerous Koalaks and once there, you'll have to show this key to the guard of Skeunk's hideout...
q.3149: It took you a while to find these boomerangs! I've been disarmed since you left! It was not the same! As promised, I'll reward you by teaching you one of my favourite spells. q.3146:
May Rushu burn what's left of your conscience!
How dare you attack such young and fragile Sadidettes!

Get out of here, you child-batterer!
q.3175:

You're the one in charge of cleaning excrement in the Tofu House!
Perfect timing! There's a lot for you to do right now! Hehe!
q.3460: I'd like you to tell me if the Bworks still live in their village and if the legend is true.
q.3177: Haha! You have no class honey. Compared to me, you look like a ninny and so much not like a Koolich! Haha, you're so ugly! Yuk! At least, I wear Moowolf. Yes, dear, Moowolf.... It's very different from what you mama wears... what is it already? Gobball? How gross... Anyway. Do you want to get in this cave? Yes or no? Adventurers used to breed their Bow Wows in here but no one knows what happened. Now, it's infested with terrible creatures. I believe they'll kill you easily. But be careful Gobbly! I won't come get you if you're in trouble! Even if I hear you cry like a girl!
q.3181: Well, it seems Lord Crow appreciated your visit. He's been quite bored lately, as he's read all of the books in this library. Having the opportunity to play with you took his mind off things for a while. By way of thanks, he's asked me to give you one of his companions to take with you as a pet.
q.6924:
Nosilla has been imprisoned for several years in a cave whose opening is blocked by a magical mechanism. Three slabs keep the entrance closed, and I know how to disable one.
This slab is located on Minotoror Island. Only Ecaflips can disable its magic, they must equip an Ecaflip's Luck and have a Piece of the Crackpot Treasure in their inventory. Unfortunately, the three slabs must be deactivated simultaneously to unlock access to the cave.
I can not help you more, if not only to give you the identity of the Xelor. Her name is Kwartzwatch, she is the Xelor responsible for greeting those souls that have just arrived from Incarnam.
q.3191: Last time I saw Lord Crow, he was hiding in the third room, or maybe in the fourth one, or was it in the seventh? or the eighth?.... Well, I don't remember.
q.3490: Good idea! Nevertheless, I've to defend myself. As a Bwork veteran I must retaliate.
q.3203: By the look on your face, you didn't understand a word of what I just said. Fortunately, you've got a map there - use it to find your way around, and organise things with your teammates. Yeah, teammates. I forgot to tell you that you won't make it if you're alone. The more of you there are, the more likely you are to make it through this terrible labyrinth. Once you're inside, you'll see that each door and each switch has a colour code.
q.3201:
What are you doing here?
You're in the Labyrinth of the Minotoror, and just like all the other adventurers who came here before you, you'll get lost. I can sense it. Well, don't count on me to come get you out again!
Pfft. Anyway. What do you want?
q.3222:
Are you scared little piggy? Don't worry... Stop whining and I'll take you out of here. I'll even give you a new saved point as you seem to have forgotten yours. So let me see what's left... Weebblyz Head? No it wouldn't be interesting for you... your butt is too soft! The Odgean Stables? No, too horrifying... Gorgor's Den? No, way too dangerous...
Well, I'll choose for you and it will be....... the Zaap of the Castle of Amakna! You should feel right at home!
q.3205: It's very easy! You need a key to enter! I used to be the only one to have the key, but things changed. I think I lost my bunch of keys on this island, but I don't know where. One of these damned creatures probably stole it from me when I was sleeping.
q.3208: At last! Blimey, you took your time, didn't you? I doubt you even listened to a word I said! You're almost at the centre of the labyrinth now, though. What can I do for you?
q.3216:
Hey there adventurer! How is it going? Do you want a Grawn? 
Oh, fine then, don't answer! I don't care.
Well, I'm sure you're trying to get into this maze but I can tell you don't know much about it! You need a special key if you want to enter and don't count on me to just hand this one over. I usually steal them from adventurers like you.
q.3218:
True... We were talking about this maze...
If you want to enter the slab room, you'll need a special key that might have to put together from Lousy Pig remains.
Once in the slab room, you can choose your destination room by stepping on the right slab. Then, you'll have to work your way to the Dragon Pig Den! However, I must warn you: You'll need another key to enter this den and you'll find it only with its owners, the terrible Porcos that you come across in this maze.
q.3500: Bworkid bring Bwork no paxifiks. You suffer, scraaaaap!!
q.3223:
You finally reached the door of the Dragon Pig's Den! I hope you managed to get the key from the Porcos! Well, now I'll ask you to give me both keys if you want to get in. Give me the key to the Dragon Pig's Den as well as that of the Dragon Pig Dungeon.
Don't be so surprised! Tourists are meant to be fooled, everybody knows that! I'll just let you wander alone in this den and I'll see you later when you get out.
q.3225:
I can also tell you more about the Porcos Rustos!
They're coarse stubborn boors and they only live to satisfy their primary needs: eating, drinking and bathing in the mud!
What else can I say? Right! They don't trust creatures that don't have a snout in the middle of their faces...
q.3232:
Well, you certainly took your time! Did you actually manage to get lost on this island?
If you want to leave, it's now or never! I can take you back for only 200 Kamas, it's not even twice as expensive as a one-way ticket! 
Wipe that look off your face. This time we'll be going against the current, so the hull of my ship will wear out a lot more!
q.3235:
Don't take advantage of my generosity. You're rich enough already.
Yiiiihooooo hooooo...
q.3506: You're the only one who can find what I need. I'm shut away in here because of my people and my overdeveloped brain.
q.3236:
Hello! My name is Ziho. I guard the ruins of this temple. I know this village and this island like the back of my hand.
I'm used to meeting adventurers like you who don't believe the history of this place to be a serious matter... and never come back! 
Let me help you with a little piece of advice. So, what do you need to know?
q.3243: Indeed, they ended up losing control over this breeding. They could no longer tame the new generations of Dragons, Dreggons and Dragoss that they had created. No one can change the nature of such creatures, or really tame them... they're way too powerful and magic to be controlled by mere mortals. Further to several incidents, the Dragon breeder apprentices decided to give up their research on Dofus and they closed this sanctuary, locking up its occupants inside forever.
q.3248:
Now everything's over... Dreggons got used to the sunlight and are now inhabiting the ruins of this island. The other Dragons still live in the sanctuary and seem to feed themselves with the adventurers who turn up there...
If you want to venture there I can help you, I'm sort of the master of the house...
q.3258:
Yess... treasures on the ground... did the sun mel' you' brain o' wha'? 
Stop repeatin' everything like a bloody parrot... It's geh'in on my nerves...

I'm goin' back to my island while it's still there... So make up your mind... You comin' or no'?
q.3259:
Well, I hope you've got good earmuffs!
Hum.... By the way....
Just to know, you're not a kid dressed up as an adult are you? 
Your parents really allowed you to come? 
Because the last kid I took with me never came back...
I bet he didn't want to leave my island but his mum's been chasing me all over the place since...

*Looks over his shoulder*

Right... Hurry up! I'm off!
q.3419:
But they were pursued by the dreadful cousin of Orukawa who wanted to avenge for him. He bled them dry as if they were Gobballs and sold their remains as sausage meat on the markets in Brakmar. What a tragic ending!
And that's how Yoshawa's rat found himself being alone. He hid in the sewers of the Castle of Amakna for many years. 
rumour has it that he met Otomaï himself, while he was testing new potions with yet unsuspected effects on turtles from Moon Island.
q.3263:
Lesson n°1:
You know that someone like you shouldn't lie to someone like me, don't you? 
So if you know where my little boy is, say it right now!
q.3272:
I'm the dungeon keeper and this dungeon contains a part of the inhabitants of this forest. I can come with you if you wish, but I'll stay far behind since I don't run as fast as you with my worn roots. 
If you want to get in, give me the key to this dungeon.
q.3286:
So now I'm sure you're wondering how I could make the Giant Kralove from Moon Island choke on my sponge items if I only got them after cutting up Sponge Mob?!
Well, buddy, I see you're following what I'm saying. It's easy! A long time ago, before I created Zaaps, I had created a time-travelling machine. 
That's right, I built it when I beached on the famous Otomai Island.
q.3282:
As I explained to you, before becoming Allister's cook, I used to sail on the most beautiful and gigantic boat of all oceans! See that of Nikos Monot? Well, mine was twelve times bigger than his. You're speechless, aren't you? 
Unfortunately, it was too big for the harbour of Amakna. It didn't even fit! Can you even imagine that? 
It was so gigantic that it beached on this rocky inlet when I arrived on Moon Island. Yep! It was so big that it linked this rocky inlet to Moon Island!
q.3288:
What was I saying...
Right, I was stuck on this island and Otomai often failed his brain trepanations and transplantations on monsters. 
For example, did you know that a Iop brain can fit in an Arachnee head?
Anyway, to help him in his noble task, his knowledge quest, I built a time-travelling machine that helped him try again some of his experiences.
q.9896: Well, remember that until the fragment has been charged, I won't be able to trade it to you for another one. Are you sure of your choice?
q.3290:
Ah, so you've just defeated the terrible Sponge Mob as well! 
With a bit of luck, you'll think about me when you end up in the Giant Kralove's stomach. 
You look pretty tense, relax! The fight's over, the sun's shining, and you're in Astrub! What more could you ask for?  
My goodness me! You're as stiff as a dried Kaliptus stick! 
Let me show you how to relax!
q.3331: Well, I'll make it short. I need pieces of Kaliptus and Koalaks.
q.9886: ... You haven't done much with your life so far. Maybe it's time to change that. You're destined to restore these fragments' radiance...
q.3294:
Snirk!
Squik snot snot gurlub squik?
Squik snif kriss trok squik!
q.3352:
To report a bug/problem you come across in-game, you can: 
 
- Click on the button in the top right-hand corner of the window next to the option menu 
- Post on the forum under the Test Server section. 
 
don't hesitate to contact the Ankama Team and submit any problem you come across here!
q.3353: You want to shear the Gobball King's wool off, don't you? Well, you either need to find the key to his den in the entrails of one of his fellow creatures, or to bring me everything that's on this list! Your choice! Both are difficult...
q.3360:
You've got it wrong sweetie pie.
The principle of such a Test Server is to test new functionalities in Dofus before everybody else to correct and fix persistent bugs, NOT to test your character... why I oughta...
q.3378: My, my, you're a brave one... you have done it. Your courage shines upon you like the burning summer sun. Walk towards your destiny and may your soul be strong and unmoveable. Leave me alone now, My turnip soup is boiling over.
q.3379: I've seen things you wouldn't believe... Huge ships on fire off the shoulder of Orion. I watched beams glitter in the dark near the Tanhauser Gate. All those... moments will be lost in time, like tears... in rain. Time to move on...
q.3421:
Well, I think I've told you everything I know about this rat and his history.
But be careful, this rat is driven by vengeance and he's training his turtles as well as other rats in the only goal to avenge his master. However, he seems to have lost his mind and he attacks anyone who dares enter his temple.
Take care, he masters the Pandawushu art better than you can ever imagine.
q.9898: Well, remember that until the fragment has been charged, I won't be able to trade it to you for another one. Are you sure of your choice?
q.3422:
How did you manage to defeat that rat? You should head over to Pandala Island and perfect your Pandawushu techniques, I'd say you have incredible potential. 
 
Anyway, follow me, I'll get you out of this rat hole!
q.3456:
My great grandfather was the one who started building the railway between the different mines of the region.
I spent a lot of time looking after them and I noticed that there was an incredible number of unexplored tunnels...
My ancestors always said there was a village hidden beneath one of these mountains above us that could only be accessed through one of the old mines. Unfortunately, we still have not found it. My faith in my grandfather is still strong... I know I'll pierce this mystery even if I've to dig through the damned rock!
q.3443: A special dish? Who do you think I am? I mean, there's meatballs, yes, but no one knows how to cook them. There's Filtounga too, but it's rare. Even Greedovores can't finish it. I don't have the recipe. Go and ask Mouss Bouff. He'll have it.
q.3447: The Filtounga is a recipe a bit heavy, but it's delicious! DEEE-LISH-ISSSS!!
q.3448: Have you got the recipe or what? Good! Go and look for the ingredients and I'll cook them.
q.3454:
Hey! What are you doing in my mine kid?
All the mines are mine! Haha!
For 50 Kamas, I can help you get out of this place. Just jump in the wagon. I'll give it a push and ride with you to the next mine.
Sometimes things can go wrong... if we end up in the wrong place, don't worry, I'll take care of you!
Dark Miners sometimes attack us, too. If you have friends, I'd advise you to bring them along... You never know...
q.3455:
Don't you know me? I'm Feldz. The greatest miner this side of Amakna! 
I've been gogorified 7 times in the last two years and I'm still here! 
I've been miner of the month for 12 years running... once I won using my teeth alone!
I'm the pride of the Enutrofs'! 
My family has been living in these mines for 21 generations. The earth hides no secret from us!
I dress up as a Dark Miner to go unnoticed, that way they leave me alone...
q.3461: I'm talking about the one which says that the Bworks have a library with giant stills that pump out Bwork beer. They must have hidden the recipe somewhere.
q.3479: Goblin tribe oppressed. Bworks want we in Workshop to make tapestry. If you spread Bwork blood, they forget we.
q.3485: Thanks, it's because I ate too many Red Goblins during the Bworkdrift battle. I stood in the White Goblins side.
q.3489: That's a Bwork's routine. But, the most difficult thing was to eat Goblin to survive since our dead had already been eaten by our Trools. If you could make me dumb again, it would be nice. I'll give you PlanBworksek's fire Gobtrotter boots.
q.3511: To start: Goblin skin, Sadida hair tuft and Trool bones. Here's a scalpel. With it, you'll be able to bone a Trool. Try the nearest dungeon or the pit.
q.3543: Hello, young Pandawa! Wait one minute... Show me your eyes! Not too sober yet... Perfect! In this state, you'll have no problem beating the hell out of your enemies. Take a good, strong axe, a few bottles of the good stuff... and fight!
q.3547: May the shadows conceal you, good Sram! That how your kind greet one another, isn't it? You prefer to lurk in the shadows... I know the type... like nothing more than slipping a knife firmly into an unsuspecting back... Just what I'm looking for!
q.3835: So, ready for the adventure of a lifetime?
q.3567: You know, when the flag is raised, the whole country stands behind it. Well, not behind it, I mean, it's too small but, well, behind it, understand? I need a flag like that, but not because I want to stand behind it. I'm not a coward.
q.3571: You bring me back some wool and it's like you've brought back victory. Wool IS victory, get it? On the other hand, if you give me the wool, the victory's yours, too. That's why wool is victory... but it's different. Cos you can't make stuff out of victory... but wool, ahh wool. Are you sure you're following me? Look, go see Shaa Kwira, she'll help you become a bit more powerful.
q.3572: You bring me back some wool and I can see a victory. Wool is victory, you get it? And yet, you give me the wool and the victory's yours. That's why wool is victory though it doesn't contain victory as you'll be keeping the victory, and this even if you give me the wool, you understand? Go and see Shaa Kwira, she'll help you to become more powerful.
q.3573: A valiant warrior, just what I need. I want you to rid the region of the terrible creatures that live there. I'd have done it myself but I've got a lot to do right now. You know, stuff, here and there, loads...
q.3590: So you think you're a good farmer? Really? We'll see about that. We need lots and lots of grain - many mouths to feed, you know. It's good for business, but I need some extra hands. Go reap a few acres of wheat.
q.3592: Mmmm. So you play around with flasks and potions? Me, I don't need that bother! Go get a couple of flax flowers so I can make some bread, then maybe we can talk.
q.3598: Lumberjack? Well, you need an expert eye and you must be willing to travel. Good trees are rare. Besides, you must preserve forests. A lot of craft industries are born from this profession. Yes really... Can you think of something that's not made out of wood? So, shall we start?
q.3599: Every society relies on its agriculture system for which the farmers are responsible. Sowing, harvesting, maintaining the soils fertile are as many tasks that the farmers are responsible for. Being a farmer is a noble profession, it feeds numerous people. Shall I start teaching you how to harvest cereals?
q.3604: Work is good for your health ... though doing nothing would be best. Being forced is the essence of work.
q.3615: Gobrator stay alone, difficult fate. No energy to live anymore. My heart does not vibrate anymore. Farewell.
q.3636: Holy mother of... what in the hell are those guards doing? You! Yeah, you.... Go make sure those pathetic slimebags are still alive! If they are, slap them round a bit for me. We're at war with Rushu, son... He could be attacking us right now!
q.3639: This is my two-handed shovel. There are many like it, but this one is mine. My shovel is my best friend. It's my life. I must master it as I must master my life. My shovel without me is useless. Without my shovel, I'm useless. I must use my shovel true. I must aim straighter than my enemy who is aiming at me.. I must get him before he gets me. I'll... My shovel and myself are the defenders of Amakna. We are the masters of our enemy. We are the saviours of my life.
q.3649: I was eating a big bowl of hot soap... no, what am I saying I was eating a big bowl of soup... that was funny, because just before, ah yes I remember, just before, I had shaved my...
q.3662: That big stone arch over there is one. It allows you to travel from one place to another in the wink of an eye.
q.3669: I'm joking. Zaaps were created by Xelor himself... to help us serve him faster! As Xelor says 'All good things come to those in haste!' These portals are fed by the energy given off by Kamas, but some of the greedy little things eat too much and get fat. Fat and lazy cosmic portals, can you imagine that? When they get lazy, they fall asleep... then they're useless. It's my job to wake them up again. How do I do this? A short, sharp shock with a hammer, my friend. That usually sorts them out
q.3908: Well looky here, a visitor... You must be shrewd to have found this hideaway... Here, take this!
q.3671: My, my... you're far too strong to stay in this part of the World of Twelve. I don't have any more missions for you. Off you go and look for the Dofus.
q.3676: You again. My, my, you're mysterious. Aren't you done with your quest yet? If at first you don't succeed... you know the rest!
q.3688: What the...? You're tellin me you can't find a friend round here.... what's your major malfunction, soldier? Square yourself up... you keep me waiting and you'll be in a world of pain.
q.3848: Adventurers often stop by taverns and Inns to recover some energy and knock back a nice, refreshing Incarnam Lemonade.
q.4010: Me, serve a prince? I'd love to, sir, but unfortunately I don't have the appropriate attire...
q.3698: You can only be here for one reason... to forget something... So, tell me, what is it? A lost love? A trade? Something you can't even utter out loud? Well, if you want me to make the right potion, you'll have to tell me!
q.3701: Just look at that city... spreading out before our eyes. It's beautiful, isn't it? One day, I'll leave myself. I'll go on a great adventure around the world, I'll drink a mimilk at the Astrub Inn. Or maybe in Bonta. OR BRAKMAR! Imagine!
q.3702: Your axe cannot cut that Elm. In between naps, the god Sadida noticed that too many people were exploiting the plants of our World. Since then, he appointed tree, flower and cereal protectors.
q.3727: Legend says that when he battled against the demons, Iop threw his sword to the ground to even up the odds. First the demons laughed. Not for long. His steady gaze followed the terrified beasts as they fled. They escaped the battlefield with their worthless lives, and Iop was victorious without lifting a finger. He left his sword where it lay to inspire courage and determination in his followers and in all other pure souls who pass.
q.3730: Laura told you about the book? I read it when I was down in Amakna... what I told Laura is only bits and pieces of the original. One day, you might be lucky enough to come across the book yourself... if you do, be sure and take in all you can!
q.3750: Gutting a fish, is easy as pie. Use this fish workbench here, you'll see the result before you start. Don't forget that you must have your tool in your hand if you want to do anything related to your profession.
q.3798: What's this? A little slug crawling up to talk to me? ME! Bah! I don't have time for this loser.
q.3804: I knew it. Wanna trade for this extremely rare item?
q.3812: You know some spells now kid. Why don't you go pay a visit some of those powerful creatures lurking in the dungeons round here?
q.3817: Incarnam Lemonade! Hem, yes, give it to me. It's ... mmmm ... essential for my concentration. OKAY. Now for the real magic... I'm going to give you all your strength back. By the way, young adventurer, take care of yourself, nothing is the same in Amakna. If you want to replenish your energy over there, you'll have to find an Inn to rest at... or potions that will restore your energy. I always go for the Incarnam Lemonade myself!
q.3818: Wading through a dungeon with a sharp sword and a good book of spells is probably the most exciting thing an adventurers will ever experience!
q.3834: So, ready for the adventure of a lifetime?
q.3851: I'm resting my tired old bones. You wouldn't believe all the adventures I've had. Hunting Gobballs, tracking Bworks, I sailed the Seven Seas, survived a dose of Maloria, challenged Dark Vlad and...
q.3853: Hey, kid, that's life. I had some great times and I've no regrets. It's the journey that counts, right? All the long days and nights I spent looking for one of those eggs... I discovered more countries than I can count, creatures as strange as a three Kama piece... some great brothers in arms, too. Hey, look, enjoy your trip round the World of Twelve... and take care.
q.3855: Aah! Feet up while admiring Astrub... this is an old dream. The only thing missing in the picture is a Dofus or two to put on top of the fireplace.
q.3860: If you find a Snoowolf skin on your trip round Incarnam, bring it here. I'll find something to trade, friend.
q.6307: You're so ugly that even the powers of 1,000 gods could not fulfil your request.
q.3861: I've been told that you've been given a task for your profession. You should really get on with it.
q.3869: As'Ruoy'Dnim was putting Amakna under his implacable yoke and letting his diabolical armies plunder and pillage. The demons were extremely powerful and everyone was too afraid to do a thing... But Allister had companions, and above all, he had a plan. Through sly trickery, he managed to lock As'Ruoy'Dnim up in a jail. Unfortunately, as I was saying, the rogues helped him to escape.
q.3873: Oh! Sugar! Where is this den!? I'm late for my nap... What? You know Yse Vewybad, the minister? You can help me then! Would you mind searching for this den?
q.3999: A pint? You don't even deserve to be kicked around by me! Disciple! Come and teach this young ignoramus a lesson!
q.3877: Eh, er, what? Whoaa I was having such a sweet dream... Okay, tell me what you found. Oh no, there's nothing in those crypts... Listen, there's a crypt south of here... The gate seems blocked, but if you try, perhaps...
q.3878: Yes, that's what we need...However, I didn't understand whether Yse Vewybad wants to kill Rogues or hire them. Maybe you'll understand better... We'll just have to ask Yse.
q.4085: Ahem, according to your constitution, I can tell that I'll need a Great Coralator relic and a Gourlo the Terrible relic to prepare your potion. Once ground to powder, I'll be able to withdraw all the magic power I need from them.
q.3911: I didn't expect anything less from you. Fallanster, the King's brother, wishes to marry his daughter the princess Allisteria to a worthy man. Obviously, this is the King's responsibility and I'm honoured I can help him in this task. We must find a suitor. Search a suitor of noble lineage and come back when you have found our gem.
q.3915: Have I seen any nobles? I sure have. A few of them at once, if you can believe it. Let me tell you, they're not so noble when I'm kicking them out the back door in the early hours of the morning!
q.3923: So, the King is marrying his niece...? Ahem... Maybe we can get a Prince on our payroll... Do you know if the princess has any other suitors?
q.3941: Ah! I'm glad you're back! So, here's the plan: you'll disguise yourself as the prince. First, find a way to pass off as a Wabbit. A potion should do. Then, go to the castle and act like you're the prince. Tell them that you object to the marriage or whatever. Think of something... we cannot let this wedding go ahead...
q.3953: Horrible marriage? But Allisteria is so... Hey! Wait a minute! You don't speak like a Wabbit! You're not the prince! Help me, my faithful Gobball!
q.3966: The assassins I found will not be able to get through the security that surrounds the prince. Find a Lenald. With your skill and his magic, he may be able to teleport you to the throne room on day of the wedding.
q.3992: You'we stwong enough now, you can join my othew companions. But you on youw own won't be enough... I need mowe attendants. Go and wecwuit some mowe!
q.4103:
You have all the necessary ingredients but what's more important to me is that you helped my friends and I thank you for that. Now, it's my turn to help you.
By changing your constitution, your characteristics will also be modified. 
Your chance, strength, intelligence, wisdom, vitality and agility can therefore be modified.
I can suggest two different potions that will enable you to change your constitution. The first one will enable you to totally forget your characteristics, whereas the second one is less powerful. 
Be careful, once you drink one of these potions you can't go back, unless you drink another potion again.
q.4111: To make ‘em keys I need... let's see: 1 Piece of the Shell of Aeroktor the Warrior, 1 Piece of the Shell of Terrakubiack the Warrior, 1 Piece of the Shell of Ignilicrobur the Warrior, 1 Piece of the Shell of Aquabralak the Warrior and last but not least 1 White Dreggon egg.
q.4104:
I'm sorry but I can't make you a potion to change your constitution, you don't have the right ingredients for it. These potions are so powerful that they require extremely rare magic essences. The more powerful the persons who must change their constitution are, the more I need ingredients.
Preparing these potions is quite a long and delicate process and I only prepare them for adventurers who are taking the time to go and help my colleagues on this island.
q.4119: And now, here comes the last and most important question: how many traumatised Kokokonuts can a Crow carry if it has 5 times less strength than you, but which has a Bherb Belt and a bag made of Pikoko hair improved by a costumagus?
q.4124:
Do you really think that you just need to accept my proposition to go on this island? You fool of the ocean depths, stupid centenarian Kralove dung!! If you go to this island you'll live a dangerous adventure! You'll have to fight the elements, the oceans and maybe even your aunts! Hehehe... I've always enjoyed making rhymes! 
Do you really want to go on this island or would you rather keep hunting Gobblies?
q.4128:
Pirates are attacking us!
I didn't even have time to throw a cannonball at them! Damn! Just do something useful for once... Charge at the enemy and kill those bloody good-for-nothing, those aquatic Raul Mobs devourer Scurvions!!
q.4138:
Hello! I'm Professor Kalkulus.
Since I lost my seven balls, I've been healing the wounded creatures of this island. Sometimes, I just have to finish them off. 
I always wanted to help living beings and put an end to their suffering. It became a genuine passion. If you have some time to dedicate me, I may need your help.
q.4150:
My colleagues wanted me to provide them with one of the best flours, the one made by Xavier the Baker!
But it's way too hard to make so I thought I'd mix a lot of different flours and just add a tiny bit of Xavier's. With a little bit of luck no one would ever notice! I had the idea but I'm still missing the flours. Do you think you can help me out and get me what I need?
q.4156: Thanks to you, I know why my son tried to get away from me. I've learnt my lesson well and will never ever call him my sweet wabbit again. From now one I'll call him my little Gobbly... I'm sure he'll love it!
q.4157:
I've hidden here because I could no longer stand my dad. He keeps on calling me my wabbit... can you imagine the torture? It's been hard enough already to accept my name as it's... I never liked my name Bugsbo Nee and besides all this, he keeps on making a fool of me in front of all my girlfriends with this stupid nickname. I'll never have a serious relationship!! 
If only my dad could understand this, I think that I'd consider seeing him again.
Can you try and explain to him what's bothering me?
q.4184: Do you know the Pirates of Otomai's Ark? These despicable creatures fire cannonballs at me whenever I fly over the ark. I've already lost many Scarplanes because of them. I'll let you use my Scarplanes if you go kill a few of them. That should set an example to the others and quiet them down a bit.
q.4179:
I now organise hunts. Modern adventurers no longer have goals. I feel I bring meaning to their life with my hunting sessions. Incidentally, it also enables me to regularly cull the creatures on the island. Otomai is against this and would rather leave nature take its course but we eventually came to an agreement and he let me beat the island's ecosystem with a stick provided that I send him all the results. 
Do you want to have a go at hunting?
q.4186:
I've heard that you managed to scare the Pirates away. They'll probably leave me alone for a while with their cannonballs!
All Scarplane pilots will be grateful to you!!
q.4200: However, I must warn you. The Tynril is an original creature which surprises many the fool. I only let the most courageous adventurers enter this old lab. To show me your value, you'll have to confront Silf the Greater Bherb. He's a terrifying enemy but if you defeat him Rubrat will give you a key to enter the lab.
q.4216:
Be careful, when you drink this potion you'll only get back the characteristic points that you invested after you reached 101.
With this potion, you won't to lose the characteristic points that you earned with scrolls.
But you won't be able to get back the characteristic points that you invested under your 101 characteristic points. 
Are you sure you want to continue?
q.4220: This giant creature became really fat and its acid and putrid excrements modified part of the island's ecosystem. Plants and all sorts of living things are dying as a result. We're afraid that it could move and contaminate the rest of the island. The oil slick it could create would be a disaster for our society.
q.4221: For now, it seems to be feeling good in its peat bog but we still had to build protections around it to prevent accidents. From time to time, my colleagues go and check the size and smell of this creature. It looks quite evil but as it's a unique and outstanding creature, it's become a priceless subject for experiments.
q.4222:
The mechanism we use to open this door is complex and secret. We don't want to spoil this creature by letting it devour stupid adventurers. 
Never forget that this creature is extremely powerful and dangerous, the dragon carcass that we found in the peat bog makes us believe that it's been killed by this creature.
q.4224:
This village, located on top of this giant tree, is inhabited by the Zoth people. They're old tourists who came to discover the island and became crazy after drinking water from the putrid peat bog. 
When you know what's in it, you can easily understand that something's wrong with them... 
However, they do live in peace, they rule themselves. They wanted to set themselves free from the society in which they lived. As long as no one disturbs them, they're well-behaved and calm.
q.4234:
We've named it Plasmogrine, and we now know it's self-aware, a frightening thought indeed. This primitive form of the organism has given us a deep insight into the mysteries of evolution... Our discoveries cast doubt over the very stability of the world!
If only Otomai had not taken this so far. I can tell you his intentions were not evil.
q.4238: Otomai's secret is well guarded. This last creation, cultivated from the most potent bacterial strains on the island, consumes everything in its path. The trans-dimensional nature of the Plasmogrine allows this creature to place its stomach in another dimension. What is more, it's quasi-immortal!
q.4257: I'll need a very good shaft to fix your weapon. Bring me a Lady Root together with your cursed sword, and I'll fix it.
q.4267: So you just think that a Bontarian bigwig could just come and work for us? Well, the timing is right... I've been thinking about that a lot lately. All the same, I hope for your sake that this Xephires is really the one who signed this document. People will talk otherwise.
q.4274: Who? Ah, it's not the last winner of the Gobball Slobber gathering contest, is it? No? Well I don't know then.
q.4368: I want you to make preparations to leave. You can expect combat. The convoy is waiting for at the south gate, but I couldn't find any more militiamen to accompany you since I needed all the men I could find for missions around the town. The public paddocks were opened during the night by some troublemakers and there are Dragoturkeys running amuck all over the city. It really is a mess. Go see Cheeka the convoy leader real quick, and don't forget to report back to me as soon as the convoy arrives safely.
q.4297:
I've a feeling you're thirsty for some Brakmarian-style action. I'm going to give you a mission that is sure to quench your thirst. 
Milone needs a Kain Dharyn crystal... these crystals are very rare and sought-after, in case you didn't know. My spies have reported that the family of Captain Starky of Bonta had a few. We simply can't attack Captain Starky directly. You're going to kidnap his niece, Sabine and demand the Kain Dharyn crystal in return. I'll mark where he lives on your map.
q.4334:
Oh, what a marvel. And if I accept everything in this letter it could be mine? 
Hm, betraying Bonta for Brakmar... I really shouldn't... but... it's such a shiny jewel.
...
I need some time to think. My stay in Pandala is almost at an end, but there's one more thing I've to sort out. Maybe you could take care of it for me, as a sign of goodwill. I've to deliver this box to Counsellor Boyowa. When you're done, Meet me in the Tower of Bonta, where you found the torn up piece of letter. After you've done all that, I'll tell you my decision.
q.4337: Xephires will await you in the Tower of Bonta - remember, that's where you found the piece of that letter the first time. Be careful not to get caught with the jewel.
q.4889: What? You arrived too late and our soldiers were already defeated? Ugh. We're so much weaker than Brakmar... it worries me.
q.4343:
Disappeared?! I don't believe it... he was one of my best clients!
Well, after his trip here, he started going to his place, a little to the east of here.
q.4473: Start by searching in the smith and mining workshops. Not the Bontarian ones, mind you... or the ones around here.
q.4348:
As you can see, there are signs of a battle in this corner. What happened? Well I found this weapon on the ground too. 
Oh, you're doing an investigation, well here's the weapon, maybe it'll come in useful. Kosuke the smith will be able to tell you where it comes from, but surely you've thought of that already.
q.4358: Ecaflips, huh... yes, I had a few of them over not so long ago. They looked dodgy too, by the way. I think I overheard them talking about someone by the name of Lodax, not that I was listening or anything.
q.4363:
I've heard about a group of bandits who are wreaking havoc through the Cania Plains, not far from the fair. They may even have come as far as here...
I want you to go investigate over there. Come back if you find something.
q.4366:
Hmm, so you gave the bandits a good beating and you even went as far as risking you life to get into their hideout. I admire your courage, but I need people with sense too. It's a pity you didn't get any further into their hideout. 
I wanted to raise a troop to go along with you, but the counsel didn't agree with me. With the new information you brought me I hope they'll change their minds. 

Here's a few potions for your injuries. Get some rest and come back to see me when you've recovered.
q.5418: Ruth Banke? I haven't seen that rascal in weeks. If you see him, tell him he better pay me back soon - my patience has its limits you know.
q.4376: Ah, I see our proposition interests you. The deal is simple: the jewel for 10,000 Kamas. And your life. I'll give you a fake jewel that you can then give to your idiot chief. So?
q.4390: I've been thinking a lot and I've come to an important decision. I'm going to cover you so you can continue your investigation and find out once and for all who betrayed Bonta. We can keep an eye on you when you're around the town, but it's not so easy when you stray outside. Go to the Sram temple and question Rigal Hookhand. I'm not fond of the guy, but he may have some useful information all the same. Let's just hope he does!
q.4392:
Hmmm, a respected citizen of Bonta... whose name starts with X.
Yes, I might have some information... but you'll have to cross my hand with silver.
The temple's poison reserves are running low and I've heard talk that Brakmar's are full to bursting point. I want you to bring me 10 Flasks of Brakmarian poison, and while you're there, you might as well borrow the client register in the alchemists' workshop. 
I won't give you a word of information until I've these items. Or a billion Kamas. 
Don't look at me like that, you must know someone in Brakmar who can help you out.
q.4396: Excellent work. I knew I could trust you. I don't think anybody noticed you were gone, but the traitor must be keeping his head down, so you'll have to keep your wits about you. I'm counting on you to wrap this investigation up, after all, it's your honour that's at stake.
q.5465: Bear enter tavern. Bear say Me want Astrub Beer...
q.4397:
Time to close the trap. Go to the Tower of Bonta. Many important citizens of the city are meeting there soon and you're going to take this chance to get into Xarthan's house. Find the documents that compromise him - when you have the documents you'll know what to do next. I don't want him finding out that you were there, so you'll need to take a handyman with you to force the lock discreetly.
Xarthan's house is in the Baker's district in Bonta. Where exactly? I don't have a clue, the sod never even invited me once! 
May Silvosse bring you luck!
q.4410: Go and post militiaman at each exit of the Tower of Orders, I don't want those devils to get away from us. We need to catch them in the act, and I'm counting on you to get it done. I'm going to send one of my spies to follow you, just in case things get ugly. And don't take just any militiaman. I want you remove the following soldiers from their current duties - Sen Eiser, Kit Dingaround, Galde Avout, Ruth Banke.
q.4398:
Ahh! Who are you? No, I was taken.
I'll tell you the truth... I was hooked on Ouassingue juice. If I didn't have a mouthful every day, I just couldn't concentrate on a thing. You're not going to turn me in, are you?
q.4412: I... it's... it's a secret. Oh darn, I suppose you know that already! No matter, I'll sort you out. No one will stop me getting this jewel. NO ONE!!
q.9906:
The adventure is its own reward. Don't you think that's a metaphor for existence? 



Take this time to reflect on the journey that's led you to this moment in your life.
q.4441:
My spies in Bonta have found someone... to assassinate... The problem is that those airheads didn't think they'd be killing anyone, so they don't have any poison on them. You must bring them some, but the only ones who have the poison they need are the Bwork Magi.
Bring this poison to the leader of the spies, he's in the South-West of Bonta.
q.4442: Ah, perfect. I'll have to avoid losing so many spies this time. The day before yesterday they mixed up a jar of poison with our stealth cream... it wasn't pretty. It's difficult to hide here as there are so many Bontarians about, so we want to you find us somewhere to lay low for a while. Try and find a location between here and the library, just so we won't have the whole of Bonta passing by. Actually, why don't you just find someone else's hideout and knock everyone in there out. Make sure you don't kill them though, we need some human guinea pigs to test the poison on. Bring 10 Flax Strings to tie them up.
q.5135: Hmm, the Order of the Stinging Slap, huh? Not bad... not bad at all. Ok, no problem. I declare the Order of the Stinging Slap OPEN! The chief of the order will be the oh-so-powerful As'Ruoy'Dnim.
q.4446:
Hm, how can I explain... My spies were seen and eaten by Whitish Fang guard dogs belonging to the Bonta militia. 
We have to take the target out. You know what I'm talking about, right?
q.4462:
You bought his allegiance to our cause!? Good thinking, very Brakmarian. I'll make sure he's sent back to Bonta so he can sabotage their militia! 50,000 Kamas? Here's a refund... plus a finder's fee!
You've got nothing to do? Good, you can go back to Bonta and find out the secret to taming Whitish Fangs. If you don't know where to start, why not go to the library first?
q.4487: On the other hand I want to do you a favour, so listen up. To make Tra Khben paste, you need to crush and mix 15 Boar Snouts, 5 Greedovore Pots and 1 Quetsnakiatl Feather. If anyone asks you where you got this information, you better not tell them anything.
